name: Imo1985P4.double_pigeonhole
statement:
lemma double_pigeonhole {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    {s : Finset α} {f₁: α → β} {f₂: (Finset α) → γ} {s₁ : Finset β} {s₂ : Finset γ}
    (hf₁ : ∀ n ∈ s, f₁ n ∈ s₁) (hf₂ : ∀ s' ⊆ s, f₂ s' ∈ s₂)
    (hs: 2 * s₂.card + s₁.card + 1 ≤ s.card)
    : ∃ t₁ t₂ : (Finset α), t₁.card = 2 ∧ t₂.card = 2
      ∧ t₁ ⊆ s ∧ t₂ ⊆ s ∧ Disjoint t₁ t₂
      ∧ (∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t₁ → f₁ n = p)
      ∧ (∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t₂ → f₁ n = p)
      ∧ (f₂ t₁ = f₂ t₂)

name: Imo1985P4.extended_pigeonhole
statement:
lemma extended_pigeonhole {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {s : Finset α} {f: α → β} {s' : Finset β} (hf : ∀ n ∈ s, f n ∈ s')
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 * n + s'.card - 1 ≤ s.card)
    : ∃ t : Finset (Finset α), t.card = n
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → t' ⊆ s)
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → t'.card = 2)
      ∧ ((t : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id)
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → ∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t' → f n = p)

name: Imo1985P6.aux_10
statement:
lemma aux_10
  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)
  (h₀ : ∀ (x : NNReal), f 1 x = ↑x)
  (h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f (n + 1) x = f n x * (f n x + 1 / ↑n))
  (f₀ : ℕ → NNReal → NNReal)
  (hf₂ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f₀ n x = (f n x).toNNReal)
  (fi : ℕ → NNReal → NNReal)
  (hmo₇ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → Function.RightInverse (fi n) (f₀ n))
  (sn : Set ℕ)
  (sb : Set NNReal)
  (fb : ↑sn → NNReal)
  (hsn₀ : sn = Set.Ici 1)
  (hfb₀ : fb = fun n:↑sn => fi (↑n) (1 - 1 / ↑↑n))
  (hsb₀ : sb = Set.range fb)
  (fr : NNReal → ℝ)
  (hfr: fr = fun x => ↑x)
  (sbr : Set ℝ)
  (hsbr: sbr = fr '' sb)
  (br: ℝ)
  (hbr₀ : IsLUB sbr br) :
  0 < br

  (hfc₃ : StrictAnti fc)
  (sb sc : Set NNReal)

  (hscr : scr = fr '' sc)
  (br cr : ℝ)
  (hbr₀ : IsLUB sbr br)
  (hcr₀ : IsGLB scr cr) :

name: Imo1985P6.aux_exists
statement:
lemma aux_exists

  (sn : Set ℕ)
  (hsn₀ : sn = Set.Ici 1)
  (fb fc : ↑sn → NNReal)
  (hfb₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sn), f₀ (↑n) (fb n) = 1 - 1 / ↑↑n)
  (hfc₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sn), f₀ (↑n) (fc n) = 1)
  (hfb₃ : StrictMono fb)
  (hfc₃ : StrictAnti fc)
  (sb sc : Set NNReal)
  (hsb₀ : sb = Set.range fb)
  (hsc₀ : sc = Set.range fc)
  (fr : NNReal → ℝ)
  (hfr : fr = fun x => ↑x)
  (sbr scr : Set ℝ)
  (hsbr : sbr = fr '' sb)
  (hscr : scr = fr '' sc)
  (br cr : ℝ)
  (h₈ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → 0 < x → 1 - 1 / ↑n < f n x → f n x < f (n + 1) x)
  (hbr₁ : 0 < br)
  (hu₅ : br ≤ cr)
  (hbr₃ : ∀ x ∈ sbr, x ≤ br)
  (hcr₃ : ∀ x ∈ scr, cr ≤ x) :
  ∃ x, ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < f n x ∧ f n x < f (n + 1) x ∧ f (n + 1) x < 1

name: Imo1985P6.aux_unique
statement:
lemma aux_unique
  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)
  (h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f (n + 1) x = f n x * (f n x + 1 / ↑n))
  (hmo₀ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → StrictMono (f n))
  (h₇ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f n x < f (n + 1) x → 1 - 1 / ↑n < f n x) :
  ∀ (y₁ y₂ : NNReal),
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < f n y₁ ∧ f n y₁ < f (n + 1) y₁ ∧ f (n + 1) y₁ < 1) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < f n y₂ ∧ f n y₂ < f (n + 1) y₂ ∧ f (n + 1) y₂ < 1) → y₁ = y₂

name: Imo1985P6.aux_unique_nhds
statement:
lemma aux_unique_nhds
  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)
  (sd : Set ℕ)
  (hsd : sd = Set.Ici 2)
  (fd : NNReal → NNReal → ↑sd → ℝ)
  (hfd₁ : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : NNReal) (n : ↑sd), fd y₁ y₂ n = f (↑n) y₂ - f (↑n) y₁)
  (hd₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sd) (a b : NNReal), a < b → 0 < fd a b n) :
  ∀ (a b : NNReal),
    a < b →
      (∀ (n : ↑sd),
        (1 - 1 / ↑↑n < f (↑n) a ∧ 1 - 1 / ↑↑n < f (↑n) b) ∧ f (↑n) a < 1 ∧ f (↑n) b < 1) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fd a b) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: Imo1985P6.aux_unique_top
statement:
lemma aux_unique_top
  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)
  (h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f (n + 1) x = f n x * (f n x + 1 / ↑n))
  (h₇ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NNReal), 0 < n → f n x < f (n + 1) x → 1 - 1 / ↑n < f n x)
  (sd : Set ℕ)
  (hsd : sd = Set.Ici 2)
  (fd : NNReal → NNReal → ↑sd → ℝ)
  (hfd₁ : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : NNReal) (n : ↑sd), fd y₁ y₂ n = f (↑n) y₂ - f (↑n) y₁)
  (hd₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sd) (a b : NNReal), a < b → 0 < fd a b n) :
  ∀ (a b : NNReal),
    a < b →
      (∀ (n : ↑sd), f (↑n) a < f (↑n + 1) a ∧ f (↑n) b < f (↑n + 1) b)
      → Filter.Tendsto (fd a b) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

name: Imo1985P6.aux_unique_top_ind
statement:
lemma aux_unique_top_ind
  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)
  (sd : Set ℕ)
  (hsd : sd = Set.Ici 2)
  (fd : NNReal → NNReal → ↑sd → ℝ)
  (hfd₁ : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : NNReal) (n : ↑sd), fd y₁ y₂ n = f (↑n) y₂ - f (↑n) y₁)
  (hd₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sd) (a b : NNReal), a < b → 0 < fd a b n)
  (a b : NNReal)
  (ha₀ : a < b)
  (hd₃ : ∀ (nd : ↑sd), nd.1 + (1 : ℕ) ∈ sd)
  (hd₂ : ∀ (nd : ↑sd), fd a b nd * (2 - 1 / ↑↑nd) ≤ fd a b ⟨nd.1 + 1, hd₃ nd⟩)
  (hi₀ : 2 ∈ sd)
  (i : ↑sd)
  (hi₁ : i = ⟨2, hi₀⟩) :
  ∀ (nd : ↑sd), fd a b i * (3 / 2) ^ (nd.1 - 2) ≤ fd a b nd

      (Even i → (C[i]'(by lia)).2 = (C[i + 1]'h).2) ∧
      (Odd i → (C[i]'(by lia)).1 = (C[i + 1]'h).1))
    (hclose : ∀ h : 0 < C.length, (C[C.length - 1]'(by lia)).1 = (C[0]'h).1) :
    ∃ ε : ℤ × ℤ → ℤ, (∀ p ∈ C.toFinset, ε p = 1 ∨ ε p = -1) ∧
      (∀ y : ℤ, ∑ p ∈ C.toFinset.filter (fun p => p.2 = y), ε p = 0) ∧

    ∃ C : List (ℤ × ℤ), C.Nodup ∧ (∀ p ∈ C, p ∈ S) ∧ 4 ≤ C.length ∧ Even C.length ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, (h : i + 1 < C.length) →

theorem constant_descent_vieta_jumping (x y : ℕ) {claim : Prop} {H : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (h₀ : H x y)
    (B : ℕ → ℤ) (C : ℕ → ℤ) (base : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (H_quad : ∀ {x y}, H x y ↔ (y : ℤ) * y - B x * y + C x = 0) (H_symm : ∀ {x y}, H x y ↔ H y x)
    (H_zero : ∀ {x}, H x 0 → claim) (H_diag : ∀ {x}, H x x → claim)
    (H_desc : ∀ {x y}, 0 < x → x < y → ¬base x y → H x y →
      ∀ y', y' * y' - B x * y' + C x = 0 → y' = B x - y → y' * y = C x → 0 ≤ y' ∧ y' ≤ x)
    (H_base : ∀ {x y}, H x y → base x y → claim) : claim

theorem exists_labeling : ∀ (k : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (S : Finset V),

    (∀ u v : V, H.Adj u v → ∃ s ∈ S, H.Reachable u s) →
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ Φ : Sym2 V → ℕ,
      (∀ e ∈ H.edgeSet, n + 1 ≤ Φ e ∧ Φ e ≤ n + k) ∧
      (∀ e₁ ∈ H.edgeSet, ∀ e₂ ∈ H.edgeSet, Φ e₁ = Φ e₂ → e₁ = e₂) ∧

      potential x - potential y

name: Imo2000P3.phase1
statement:
lemma phase1 (hn : 2 ≤ n) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 1 / ((n : ℝ) - 1) ≤ lam)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : 0 < potential x) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ y, Reachable lam x y ∧ potential x ≤ potential y ∧
      rightmost x + (t : ℝ) * (lam * potential x / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ rightmost y

name: Imo2000P3.phase2
statement:
lemma phase2 (hn : 2 ≤ n) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (M : ℝ) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y : Fin n → ℝ, (univ.filter fun k => y k ≤ M).card ≤ m →
      M < rightmost y → ∃ z, Reachable lam y z ∧ ∀ l, M < z l

    potential x = (n : ℝ) * rightmost x - ∑ i, x i

name: Imo2000P3.strat_step
statement:

    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : 0 < potential x) :
    ∃ y, Move lam x y ∧
      rightmost x + lam * potential x / ((n : ℝ) - 1) ≤ rightmost y ∧
      potential x ≤ potential y

name: Imo2005P6.cong_aux
statement:
theorem cong_aux : ∀ (P st : Finset (Fin 6)), P ⊆ Finset.univ.erase 5 → P.card = 2 →
    st.card = 4 →
    ((if P ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      - ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P, (if ({u, 5} : Finset (Fin 6)) ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      - ∑ Q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P).powersetCard 2,
          (if Q ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) ≡ 0 [ZMOD 3]

    ∃ t : Finset (Fin 6), s ⊆ t ∧ t.card = k

name: Imo2005P6.pairCount_modEq
statement:
theorem pairCount_modEq {n : ℕ} {s : Fin n → Finset (Fin 6)} {c0 : Fin n}
    (hc0 : s c0 = Finset.univ.erase 5) (h4 : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ c0 → (s i).card = 4)
    {P : Finset (Fin 6)} (hP : P ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 : Finset (Fin 6)).powersetCard 2) :
    (pairCount s P : ℤ)
      ≡ 1 + ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P, (pairCount s {u, 5} : ℤ)
        + ∑ Q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P).powersetCard 2, (pairCount s Q : ℤ) [ZMOD 3]

name: Imo2005P6.pairCount_two

name: Imo2005P6.sum_pairCount
statement:

    ∑ P ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)).powersetCard 2, pairCount s P
      = ∑ i, ((s i).powersetCard 2).card

      ∑ j ∈ Finset.filter (fun j : Fin m => j ≤ (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Fin m)) Finset.univ,

    (h : σ.move (aliceHist σ t) = Move.ask S) :
    alicePlay σ (t + 1) =
      if ∑ x ∈ S, weightBase ^ (aliceStreak σ t x) ≤
          ∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, weightBase ^ (aliceStreak σ t x)
      then (fun x => if x ∈ S then aliceStreak σ t x + 1 else 0,
            aliceHist σ t ++ [false], false)
      else (fun x => if x ∉ S then aliceStreak σ t x + 1 else 0,
            aliceHist σ t ++ [true], true)

    (h : bobStateOf N k ans (t + 1) = ⟨P, BobPhase.probe j⟩)
    (hcard : ¬ P.card ≤ 2 ^ k) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    bobStateOf N k ans t = ⟨P, BobPhase.probe (j - 1)⟩ ∧ ans t = false

name: Imo2012P3.bob_backward_probe_chain

    (h : bobStateOf N k ans t = ⟨P, BobPhase.probe j⟩)
    (hcard : ¬ P.card ≤ 2 ^ k) (hi : i ≤ j) (ht : j ≤ t) :
    bobStateOf N k ans (t - i) = ⟨P, BobPhase.probe (j - i)⟩ ∧
      (1 ≤ i → ans (t - i) = false)

name: Imo2013P5.fixed_point_of_gt_1

    (H2 : ∀ x y, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x + f y ≤ f (x + y))
    (H4 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ≤ f n)
    (H5 : ∀ x : ℚ, 1 < x → (x : ℝ) ≤ f x)
    {a : ℚ} (ha1 : 1 < a) (hae : f a = a) :

    (H4 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ≤ f n)
    (H5 : ∀ x : ℚ, 1 < x → (x : ℝ) ≤ f x)

    Multiset.count n (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k,
        (if (n = 2 * m + 1 ∨ n = 2 * m + 2) then Multiset.count n c else 0)

    (hcap : value c ≤ cap k) :
    ∃ gs : Multiset (Multiset ℕ), gs.sum = c ∧ gs.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ g ∈ gs, value g ≤ 1

    ∃ gs : Multiset (Multiset ℕ), gs.sum = c ∧ gs.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ g ∈ gs, value g ≤ 1

      + c.filter (fun p ↦ 2 * k + 1 ≤ p) = c

name: Imo2014P5.greedy
statement:

    (∀ n ∈ pile, 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) → ∀ w : Fin k → ℚ, (∀ m, w m ≤ 1) →
    value pile + ∑ m, w m ≤ cap k →
    ∃ parts : Fin k → Multiset ℕ,
      (∑ m, parts m) = pile ∧ ∀ m, w m + value (parts m) ≤ 1

statement:
lemma mem_frontier_iff {L : Finset Line} {σ : Line → Bool} (hne : (Cell L σ).Nonempty)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} :
    p ∈ frontier (Cell L σ) ↔
      (∀ ℓ ∈ L, sgn (σ ℓ) * ℓ.val p ≥ 0) ∧ (∃ ℓ ∈ L, ℓ.val p = 0)

name: Imo2014P6.mem_lows
statement:
lemma mem_lows {L : Finset Line} {σ : Line → Bool} {ℓ m : Line} :

name: Imo2014P6.mem_upps
statement:
lemma mem_upps {L : Finset Line} {σ : Line → Bool} {ℓ m : Line} :
    m ∈ upps L σ ℓ ↔ m ∈ L ∧ m ≠ ℓ ∧ sgn (σ m) * ℓ.det m < 0

    (Wi.s_r hGP hiL - Wi.s_b hGP hiL) * (Wj.s_r hGP hjL - Wi.s_b hGP hiL) < 0

    (∀ m ∈ L, 0 ≤ sgn (σ m) * m.val (ℓ.param t)) ↔
      (∀ m ∈ lows L σ ℓ, ℓ.crossT m ≤ t) ∧ (∀ m ∈ upps L σ ℓ, t ≤ ℓ.crossT m)

      ((Finset.range (n - δ)).filter

statement:
lemma vital_color_count_identity (k : ℕ) (f : Fin (3 * k) → Fin (3 * k) → Letter)
    (c : Letter) :
    colorCount f (vitalRowCells k) c + colorCount f (vitalColCells k) c +
        colorCount f (vitalSumCells k) c + colorCount f (vitalDiffCells k) c =
      colorCount f Finset.univ c + 3 * colorCount f (centerCells k) c

name: Imo2016P2.vital_incidence_indicator

        (if p ∈ vitalColCells k then 1 else 0) +
        (if p ∈ vitalSumCells k then 1 else 0) +
        (if p ∈ vitalDiffCells k then 1 else 0) =
      1 + 3 * (if p ∈ centerCells k then 1 else 0)

name: Imo2017P3.maintSeq_spec
statement:
lemma maintSeq_spec (σ : Strategy) (hσ : ValidStrategy σ) (a : Pt) (L : List Pt)
    (hd : 100 ≤ dist a (σ L)) (k : ℕ) :
    (maintSeq σ a L k).2 =
        L ++ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (maintSeq σ a L (i + 1)).1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → dist ((maintSeq σ a L i).1) ((maintSeq σ a L (i + 1)).1) = 1) ∧

statement:
theorem aux : ∀ (N M : ℕ) (c : Fin M → Fin N),
    (∀ k, N + 1 ≤ (univ.filter fun i ↦ c i = k).card) →
    ∃ f : Fin (2 * N) ↪o Fin M,
      (∀ k, (univ.filter fun i ↦ c (f i) = k).card = 2) ∧
      ∀ i j, c (f i) = c (f j) → i = j ∨ i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val

name: Imo2017P5.main_aux

theorem main_aux (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (a : Fin (N * (N + 1)) → ℕ)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) :
    ∃ f : Fin (2 * N) ↪o Fin (N * (N + 1)), ∀ k : Fin N, ∀ i j : Fin (2 * N),
      (univ.filter fun t ↦ a (f t) > a (f i)).card = 2 * k.val →
      (univ.filter fun t ↦ a (f t) > a (f j)).card = 2 * k.val + 1 →
      i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val

        padicValInt p (a (n - 1)) = padicValInt p k ∧ padicValInt p (a n) = padicValInt p (a 0)) ∧

    (padicValInt p (a 0) < padicValInt p k →

name: Imo2019P3.toggle_adj
statement:
lemma toggle_adj {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c x y : V} :
    ((G.deleteEdges {s(a, b), s(a, c)}) ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(b, c)}).Adj x y ↔
      (G.Adj x y ∧ s(x, y) ≠ s(a, b) ∧ s(x, y) ≠ s(a, c)) ∨ (s(x, y) = s(b, c) ∧ x ≠ y)

name: Imo2019P3.toggle_adj_a
statement:
lemma toggle_adj_a {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c : V}
    (hab : G.Adj a b) (hac : G.Adj a c) (w : V) :
    ((G.deleteEdges {s(a, b), s(a, c)}) ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(b, c)}).Adj a w ↔
      G.Adj a w ∧ w ≠ b ∧ w ≠ c

name: Imo2019P3.toggle_adj_b
statement:
lemma toggle_adj_b {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c : V} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hab : G.Adj a b) (w : V) :
    ((G.deleteEdges {s(a, b), s(a, c)}) ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(b, c)}).Adj b w ↔
      (w = c ∨ (G.Adj b w ∧ w ≠ a))

name: Imo2019P3.toggle_adj_c
statement:
lemma toggle_adj_c {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c : V} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hac : G.Adj a c) (w : V) :
    ((G.deleteEdges {s(a, b), s(a, c)}) ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(b, c)}).Adj c w ↔
      (w = b ∨ (G.Adj c w ∧ w ≠ a))

Imo2019P5.card_filter_pair
statement:
theorem card_filter_pair {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (univ.filter fun c : Fin n → Bool ↦ c i = true ∧ c j = true).card = 2 ^ (n - 2)

name: Imo2019P5.card_filter_true
statement:
theorem card_filter_true {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    (univ.filter fun c : Fin n → Bool ↦ c i = true).card = 2 ^ (n - 1)

name: Imo2019P5.card_filter_true_eq_card_filter_false
statement:
theorem card_filter_true_eq_card_filter_false {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    (univ.filter fun c : Fin n → Bool ↦ c i = true).card
      = (univ.filter fun c : Fin n → Bool ↦ c i = false).card

name: Imo2019P5.headsZ_update
statement:
theorem headsZ_update {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) (p : Fin n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (if Function.update c p (!c p) i then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (∑ i : Fin n, (if c i then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) + (if c p then (-1 : ℤ) else 1)

name: Imo2019P5.iter_meas
statement:
theorem iter_meas {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℤ) ≤ meas c) :
    meas (step^[m] c) = meas c - (m : ℤ)

name: Imo2019P5.iterate_L
statement: theorem iterate_L {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) : step^[L c] c = fun _ ↦ false

name: Imo2019P5.le_orderEmbOfFin
statement:
theorem le_orderEmbOfFin {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin S.card) :
    (j : ℕ) ≤ (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl j).val

name: Imo2019P5.meas_def
statement:
theorem meas_def {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) :
    meas c = 2 * (weightedSum c : ℤ) - (numHeads c : ℤ) ^ 2

name: Imo2019P5.meas_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem meas_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) : meas c = 0 ↔ numHeads c = 0

name: Imo2019P5.meas_ge_numHeads
statement: theorem meas_ge_numHeads {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) : (numHeads c : ℤ) ≤ meas c

name: Imo2019P5.meas_nonneg
statement: theorem meas_nonneg {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) : 0 ≤ meas c

name: Imo2019P5.not_iterate_lt_L
statement:
theorem not_iterate_lt_L {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < L c) :
    step^[m] c ≠ fun _ ↦ false

name: Imo2019P5.numHeads_cast
statement:
theorem numHeads_cast {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) :
    (numHeads c : ℤ) = ∑ i : Fin n, (if c i then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

name: Imo2019P5.numHeads_mul_succ_le
statement:
theorem numHeads_mul_succ_le {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) :
    numHeads c * (numHeads c + 1) ≤ 2 * weightedSum c

name: Imo2019P5.step_meas
statement:
theorem step_meas {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) (h : numHeads c ≠ 0) :
    meas (step c) = meas c - 1

name: Imo2019P5.sum_four_L
statement:
theorem sum_four_L {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    4 * ∑ c : Fin n → Bool, (L c : ℤ) = 2 ^ n * n * (n + 1)

name: Imo2019P5.sum_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_indicator {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ c : Fin n → Bool, (if c i then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 2 ^ (n - 1)

name: Imo2019P5.sum_range_card_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_card_le {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    S.card * (S.card - 1) ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ S, (i : ℕ)

name: Imo2019P5.two_mul_card_filter_pair
statement:
theorem two_mul_card_filter_pair {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    2 * (univ.filter fun c : Fin n → Bool ↦ c i = true ∧ c j = true).card = 2 ^ (n - 1)

name: Imo2019P5.weightedSum_cast
statement:
theorem weightedSum_cast {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) :
    (weightedSum c : ℤ) = ∑ i : Fin n, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) * (if c i then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

name: Imo2019P5.weightedZ_update
statement:
theorem weightedZ_update {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Bool) (p : Fin n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) * (if Function.update c p (!c p) i then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (∑ i : Fin n, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) * (if c i then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
        + ((p : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) * (if c p then (-1 : ℤ) else 1)

name: Imo2020P3.altCount_closed
statement:
lemma altCount_closed {a b : E → V} {vs : List V} {es : List E} (h : IsWalk a b vs es)
    (hc : vs.head? = vs.getLast?) (hL : Even es.length) (x : V) :
    ((es.mapIdx fun i e => if i % 2 = 0 then mult a b e x else 0).sum) =
      vs.dropLast.count x

name: Imo2020P3.altCount_eq
statement:
lemma altCount_eq {a b : E → V} {vs : List V} {es : List E} (h : IsWalk a b vs es)
    (hne : es ≠ []) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ 1) (x : V) :
    ((es.mapIdx fun i e => if s = i % 2 then mult a b e x else 0).sum) =
      ((vs.drop 1).dropLast.count x) +
        (if vs.head? = some x ∧ s = 0 then 1 else 0) +
        (if vs.getLast? = some x ∧ s = (es.length - 1) % 2 then 1 else 0)

name: Imo2021P5.coloring_succ
statement:
theorem coloring_succ (p : Position) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2021)
    (H : ∀ k : Fin 2021,
      ¬((((p.nth k).swapped k).1 < k ∧ k < ((p.nth k).swapped k).2) ∨
        (((p.nth k).swapped k).2 < k ∧ k < ((p.nth k).swapped k).1))) :
    (∀ x, coloring p (j + 1) x =
        Function.update (coloring p j) ((move^[j] (p, 0)).1.symm ⟨j, hj⟩) true x) ∧
      coloring p j ((move^[j] (p, 0)).1.symm ⟨j, hj⟩) = false ∧
      coloring p j ((move^[j] (p, 0)).1.symm ⟨j, hj⟩ - 1) =

    (hs : ∀ k, ∑ b ∈ B k, b = m ^ (k.val + 1))
    (hrel : ∀ a : A, (∑ k, incidenceCoeff B a k * t k) = 0) :
    ∑ k, t k * m ^ (k.val + 1) = 0

name: Imo2021P6.siegel_incidence_relation
statement:
lemma siegel_incidence_relation (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hB : ∀ k, B k ⊆ A)
    (hs : ∀ k, ∑ b ∈ B k, b = m ^ (k.val + 1)) (hlt_two : 2 * A.card < m) :
    ∃ t : Fin m → ℤ, t ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ a : A, ∑ k, incidenceCoeff B a k * t k = 0) ∧
    ∀ k, |t k| < m

name: Imo2021P6.small_coeffs_eq_zero_of_sum_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma small_coeffs_eq_zero_of_sum_pow_eq_zero (hm : 2 ≤ m) : ∀ n (c : Fin n → ℤ),
    (∀ i, |c i| < m) → (∑ i, c i * m ^ (i : ℕ) = 0) → ∀ i, c i = 0

name: Imo2021P6.small_relation_eq_zero
statement:
lemma small_relation_eq_zero (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hsmall : ∀ k : Fin m, |t k| < m)
    (hpoly : ∑ k, t k * m ^ (k.val + 1) = 0) : t = 0

name: Imo2021P6.subset_sum_eq_subtype_sum
statement:
lemma subset_sum_eq_subtype_sum (hC : C ⊆ A) :
    (∑ a : A, if (a : ℤ) ∈ C then (a : ℤ) else 0) = ∑ c ∈ C, c

name: Imo2021P6.term_mul_subset_indicator
statement:
lemma term_mul_subset_indicator : t k * (if a ∈ B k then a else 0) =
    a * (incidenceCoeff B a k * t k)

name: Imo2022P1.Coin.flip_eq_iff
statement: lemma Coin.flip_eq_iff (c c' : Coin) : c.flip = c' ↔ c ≠ c'

name: Imo2022P1.Coin.flip_eq_iff'
statement: lemma Coin.flip_eq_iff' (c c' : Coin) : c = c'.flip ↔ c ≠ c'

name: Imo2022P1.List.alternateSum_pos_of_nat
statement:
lemma List.alternateSum_pos_of_nat (l : List ℕ) (head : Bool)
  (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) (hl': 2 ≤ l.length)
  : 0 < List.alternateSum l head

name: Imo2022P1.List.blockIndex_lt
statement:
lemma List.blockIndex_lt {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : blockIndex l k < (blocks l).length

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_append
statement:
lemma List.blocks_append {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {a b : List α} (hab : ∀ x ∈ a.getLast?, ∀ y ∈ b.head?, (x == y) = false)
  : List.blocks (a ++ b) = List.blocks a ++ List.blocks b

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_drop
statement:
lemma List.blocks_drop {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : ℕ)
  : List.blocks (l.drop ((List.blocks l).take k).sum) = (List.blocks l).drop k

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_drop_take
statement:
lemma List.blocks_drop_take {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (p q : ℕ)
  : List.blocks ((l.drop ((List.blocks l).take p).sum).take (((List.blocks l).drop p).take q).sum) = ((List.blocks l).drop p).take q

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_listOfBlock
statement:
lemma List.blocks_listOfBlock (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin) (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x)
  : List.blocks (listOfBlocks l head) = l

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_left_getLast?
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_left_getLast? (l : List Coin) (k : Fin l.length) (h : (List.chainLeft l k).val ≠ 0)
  : (l.take (List.chainLeft l k)).getLast? = l.head?.map (fun x ↦ if Even (blockIndex l k) then x.flip else x)

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_left_head?
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_left_head? {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length) (h : (List.chainLeft l k).val ≠ 0)
  : (l.take (List.chainLeft l k)).head? = l.head?

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_left_segment
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_left_segment {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.blocks (l.take (List.chainLeft l k)) = (List.blocks l).take (List.blockIndex l k)

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_middle_getLast?
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_middle_getLast? (l : List Coin) (k : Fin l.length)
  : ((l.drop (List.chainLeft l k)).take (List.chainRight l k + 1 - List.chainLeft l k)).getLast? = l.head?.map (fun x ↦ if Even (blockIndex l k) then x else x.flip)

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_middle_segment
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_middle_segment {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.blocks ((l.drop (List.chainLeft l k)).take (List.chainRight l k + 1 - List.chainLeft l k)) = ((List.blocks l).drop (List.blockIndex l k)).take 1

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_right_head?
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_right_head? (l : List Coin) (k : Fin l.length) (h : (List.chainRight l k).val ≠ l.length - 1)
  : (l.drop (List.chainRight l k + 1)).head? = l.head?.map (fun x ↦ if Even (blockIndex l k) then x.flip else x)

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_operation_right_segment
statement:
lemma List.blocks_operation_right_segment {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.blocks (l.drop (List.chainRight l k + 1)) = (List.blocks l).drop (List.blockIndex l k + 1)

name: Imo2022P1.List.blocks_take
statement:
lemma List.blocks_take {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : ℕ)
  : List.blocks (l.take ((List.blocks l).take k).sum) = (List.blocks l).take k

name: Imo2022P1.List.chainLeft_eq
statement:
lemma List.chainLeft_eq {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.chainLeft l k = (List.take (List.blockIndex l k) (List.blocks l)).sum

name: Imo2022P1.List.chainLeft_le
statement:
lemma List.chainLeft_le {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.chainLeft l k ≤ k

name: Imo2022P1.List.chainLeft_le_chainRight
statement:
lemma List.chainLeft_le_chainRight {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.chainLeft l k ≤ List.chainRight l k

name: Imo2022P1.List.chainRight_succ_eq
statement:
lemma List.chainRight_succ_eq {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : List.chainRight l k + 1 = (List.take (List.blockIndex l k + 1) (List.blocks l)).sum

name: Imo2022P1.List.count_move
statement:
lemma List.count_move {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (l : List α) (x : α)
  : (List.move a b l).count x = l.count x

name: Imo2022P1.List.count_ofFn
statement:
lemma List.count_ofFn {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → α) (a : α)
  : #{i | f i = a} = List.count a (List.ofFn f)

name: Imo2022P1.List.exists_replicate_of_isChain_beq
Imo2022P1.List.head?_flatten_of_nil_not_mem
statement:
lemma List.head?_flatten_of_nil_not_mem {α : Type u} {l : List (List α)} (hl : [] ∉ l)
  : l.flatten.head? = l.head?.bind (fun l' ↦ l'.head?)

name: Imo2022P1.List.head?_get?_segments_blockIndex_ne_of
statement:
lemma List.head?_get?_segments_blockIndex_ne_of {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (a b : ℕ)
  (hab : b = a + 1) (hb : b < (List.segments l).length)
  : (List.segments l)[a]?.bind (fun x ↦ x.head?) ≠ (List.segments l)[b]?.bind (fun x ↦ x.head?)

name: Imo2022P1.List.head?_listOfBlocks
statement:
lemma List.head?_listOfBlocks (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin) (hl : l ≠ []) (hl' : 0 < l.head hl)
  : (listOfBlocks l head).head? = some head

name: Imo2022P1.List.isChain_beq_replicate
statement:
lemma List.isChain_beq_replicate {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (n : ℕ) (i : α)
  : List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ (x == y) = true) (List.replicate n i)

name: Imo2022P1.List.le_chainRight
statement:
lemma List.le_chainRight {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : k ≤ List.chainRight l k

name: Imo2022P1.List.length_blocks_append_le
statement:
lemma List.length_blocks_append_le {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {a b : List α}
  : (List.blocks (a ++ b)).length ≤ (List.blocks a).length + (List.blocks b).length

name: Imo2022P1.List.length_blocks_append_lt_of
statement:
lemma List.length_blocks_append_lt_of {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {a b : List α} (hab : ∃ x ∈ a.getLast?, ∃ y ∈ b.head?, (x == y) = true)
  : (List.blocks (a ++ b)).length < (List.blocks a).length + (List.blocks b).length

name: Imo2022P1.List.length_move
statement:
lemma List.length_move {α : Type u} {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (l : List α)
  : (List.move a b l).length = l.length

name: Imo2022P1.List.listOfBlocks_blocks
statement:
lemma List.listOfBlocks_blocks (l : List Coin)
  : ∃ coin : Coin, listOfBlocks (List.blocks l) (coin) = l

name: Imo2022P1.List.lt_alternateSum_of_nat_mem
statement:
lemma List.lt_alternateSum_of_nat_mem (l : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (h : x ∈ l)
  (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) (hl': 4 ≤ l.length)
  : x < max (List.alternateSum l true) (List.alternateSum l false)

name: Imo2022P1.List.lt_sum_take_succ_blockIndex_blocks
statement:
lemma List.lt_sum_take_succ_blockIndex_blocks {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : k < (List.take (blockIndex l k + 1) (blocks l)).sum

name: Imo2022P1.List.some_get_eq_head?_get?_segments_blockIndex
statement:
lemma List.some_get_eq_head?_get?_segments_blockIndex {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : some (l.get k) = (List.segments l)[List.blockIndex l k]?.bind (fun x ↦ x.head?)

name: Imo2022P1.List.splitBy_append'
statement:
lemma List.splitBy_append' {α : Type u} {r : α → α → Bool} {a b : List α} (hab : ∃ x ∈ a.getLast?, ∃ y ∈ b.head?, r x y = true)
  : List.splitBy r (a ++ b) = (List.splitBy r a).dropLast ++ [(List.splitBy r a).getLast?.getD [] ++ (List.splitBy r b).head?.getD []] ++ (List.splitBy r b).tail

name: Imo2022P1.List.sum_blocks
statement:
lemma List.sum_blocks {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α)
  : List.sum (List.blocks l) = l.length

name: Imo2022P1.List.sum_eq_alternateSum_add_alternateSum
statement:
lemma List.sum_eq_alternateSum_add_alternateSum {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α]
  (l : List α) (head : Bool)
  : List.sum l = List.alternateSum l head + List.alternateSum l !head

name: Imo2022P1.List.sum_rotate
statement: lemma List.sum_rotate {α : Type u} [AddCommMonoid α] (l : List α) {n : ℕ} : (l.rotate n).sum = l.sum

name: Imo2022P1.List.sum_take_blockIndex_blocks_le
statement:
lemma List.sum_take_blockIndex_blocks_le {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (k : Fin l.length)
  : (List.take (blockIndex l k) (blocks l)).sum ≤ k

name: Imo2022P1.List.zero_lt_of_mem_blocks
statement:
lemma List.zero_lt_of_mem_blocks {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : ℕ) (h : x ∈ List.blocks l)
  : 0 < x

name: Imo2022P1.Nat.ceilDiv_two_add_floorDiv_two
statement: lemma Nat.ceilDiv_two_add_floorDiv_two (n : Nat) : n ⌈/⌉ 2 + n ⌊/⌋ 2 = n

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_eq_iff
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_eq_iff {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : Row n) :
  c.blocks = [n, n] ↔ (∃ coin, ∀ (i : Fin (2 * n)), c i = coin ↔ ↑i < n)

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_ofBlocks
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_ofBlocks {n : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin) (hl : l.sum = 2 * n) (hl' : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x)
  : (Row.ofBlocks l head hl).blocks = l

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_operationOneBased_eq_blocks_of
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_operationOneBased_eq_blocks_of
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) = 0)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn) c).blocks = blocks

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_operationOneBased_eq_rotate_one_blocks_of
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_operationOneBased_eq_rotate_one_blocks_of
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (h_blocks : Even blocks.length) (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) = blocks.length - 1)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn) c).blocks = (blocks.reverse.rotate 1).reverse

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_blocks_of
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_blocks_of
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {i : ℕ} {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ}(hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) = 0)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn)^[i] c).blocks = blocks

name: Imo2022P1.Row.blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_rotate_blocks_of
statement:
lemma Row.blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_rotate_blocks_of
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {i : ℕ} {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (h_blocks : Even blocks.length) (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk : ∀ x ∈ blocks, 2 * n < x + k)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn)^[i] c).blocks = (blocks.reverse.rotate i).reverse

name: Imo2022P1.Row.chainLeft_eq_chainLeft_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.chainLeft_eq_chainLeft_ofFn {n : ℕ} (c : Row n) (k : Fin (2 * n))
  : c.chainLeft k = (Fin.cast (by rw [List.length_ofFn]) (List.chainLeft (List.ofFn c) (Fin.cast (by rw [List.length_ofFn]) k)))

name: Imo2022P1.Row.chainRight_eq_chainRight_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.chainRight_eq_chainRight_ofFn {n : ℕ} (c : Row n) (k : Fin (2 * n))
  : c.chainRight k = (Fin.cast (by rw [List.length_ofFn]) (List.chainRight (List.ofFn c) (Fin.cast (by rw [List.length_ofFn]) k)))

name: Imo2022P1.Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_two
statement:
lemma Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_eq_two
  {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk₁ : n ≤ k) (hk₂ : k ≤ 3 * n ⌈/⌉ 2)
  {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid) {l : ℕ} (hl : l = c.blocks.length)
  : ∃ i, ((Row.operationOneBased (by lia : 1 ≤ k) (by rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div] at hk₂; lia))^[i] c).blocks.length = 2

name: Imo2022P1.Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_lt
statement:
lemma Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_lt
  {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk₁ : n ≤ k) (hk₂ : k ≤ 3 * n ⌈/⌉ 2)
  {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid) (hc' : 2 < c.blocks.length)
  : ∃ i, ((Row.operationOneBased (by lia : 1 ≤ k) (by rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div] at hk₂; lia))^[i] c).blocks.length < c.blocks.length

name: Imo2022P1.Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_lt_of
statement:
lemma Row.exists_length_blocks_operationOneBased_iterate_lt_of
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (h_blocks : Even blocks.length)
  (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (h_blocks' : ∀ x ∈ blocks, x ≤ k - 1)
  {m : ℕ} (hm : blocks.reverse.findIdx? (fun x ↦ x + k ≤ 2 * n) = some m)
  : ∃ i, ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn)^[i] c).blocks.length < c.blocks.length

name: Imo2022P1.Row.leftmostNSame_iff_length_blocks_ofFn_of_valid
statement:
lemma Row.leftmostNSame_iff_length_blocks_ofFn_of_valid {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid)
  : c.leftmostNSame ↔ (c.blocks).length = 2

name: Imo2022P1.Row.leftmostNSame_iff_of_valid
statement:
lemma Row.leftmostNSame_iff_of_valid {n : ℕ} {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid):
  c.leftmostNSame ↔ ∃ coin : Coin , ∀ i, c i = coin ↔ i < n

name: Imo2022P1.Row.length_blocks_operationOneBased_lt_of_middle
statement:
lemma Row.length_blocks_operationOneBased_lt_of_middle
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk₁ : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) ≠ 0) (hk₂ : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) ≠ blocks.length - 1)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn) c).blocks.length < blocks.length

name: Imo2022P1.Row.length_blocks_operationOneBased_lt_of_odd_last
statement:
lemma Row.length_blocks_operationOneBased_lt_of_odd_last
  {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) {c : Row n}
  {blocks : List ℕ} (h_blocks : Odd blocks.length) (h_blocks' : 2 ≤ blocks.length) (hc : c.blocks = blocks) (hk : indexInBlock blocks (k - 1) = blocks.length - 1)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn) c).blocks.length < blocks.length

name: Imo2022P1.Row.ofBlocks_blocks
statement:
lemma Row.ofBlocks_blocks {n : ℕ} (c : Row n)
  : ∃ coin : Coin, Row.ofBlocks c.blocks (coin) c.sum_blocks = c

name: Imo2022P1.Row.ofBlocks_valid_iff_alternateSum_eq
statement:
lemma Row.ofBlocks_valid_iff_alternateSum_eq {n : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin) (hl : l.sum = 2 *n) (head' : Bool)
  : (Row.ofBlocks l head hl).valid ↔ List.alternateSum l head' = n

name: Imo2022P1.Row.ofFn_move_eq_move_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.ofFn_move_eq_move_ofFn {n : ℕ} (c : Row n) {a b : Fin (2 * n)} (hab : a ≤ b)
  : List.ofFn (c.move a b) = List.move a b (List.ofFn c)

name: Imo2022P1.Row.ofFn_operationOneBased_eq_operationOneBased_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.ofFn_operationOneBased_eq_operationOneBased_ofFn {n k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) (c : Row n)
  : List.ofFn (c.operationOneBased hk1 hkn) = List.operationOneBased (List.ofFn c) hk1 (by
    rw [List.length_ofFn]
    exact hkn
  )

name: Imo2022P1.Row.ofFn_operation_eq_operation_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.ofFn_operation_eq_operation_ofFn {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (2 * n)) (c : Row n)
  : List.ofFn (c.operation k) = List.operation (List.ofFn c) (Fin.cast (by rw [List.length_ofFn]) k)

name: Imo2022P1.Row.operationOneBased_iterate_valid
statement:
lemma Row.operationOneBased_iterate_valid  {n k: ℕ} {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n) (i : ℕ)
  : ((Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn)^[i] c).valid

name: Imo2022P1.Row.operationOneBased_valid
statement:
lemma Row.operationOneBased_valid  {n k: ℕ} {c : Row n} (hc : c.valid) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ 2 * n)
  : (Row.operationOneBased hk1 hkn c).valid

name: Imo2022P1.Row.sum_blocks
statement:
lemma Row.sum_blocks {n : ℕ} (c : Row n)
  : List.sum (Row.blocks c) = 2 * n

name: Imo2022P1.Row.valid_iff_isValidRow_ofFn
statement:
lemma Row.valid_iff_isValidRow_ofFn {n : ℕ}  (c : Row n)
  : c.valid ↔ isValidRow (List.ofFn c)

name: Imo2022P1.blocks_semi_inj
statement:
lemma blocks_semi_inj {a b : List Coin} (hab : List.blocks a = List.blocks b)
  (hab' : a.head? = b.head?) : a = b

name: Imo2022P1.blocks_semi_inj_helper
statement:
lemma blocks_semi_inj_helper {a b: List (List Coin)}
  (hab : a.map List.length = b.map List.length)
  (hab' : (a.head?.bind fun l' ↦ l'.head?) = (b.head?.bind fun l' ↦ l'.head?))
  (ha₁ : [] ∉ a) (hb₁ : [] ∉ b)
  (ha₂ : ∀ l ∈ a, List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ (x == y) = true) l)
  (hb₂ : ∀ l ∈ b, List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ (x == y) = true) l)
  (ha₃ : List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ ∃ (hx : x ≠ []) (hy : y ≠ []), (x.getLast hx == y.head hy) = false) a)
  (hb₃ : List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ ∃ (hx : x ≠ []) (hy : y ≠ []), (x.getLast hx == y.head hy) = false) b)
  : a = b

name: Imo2022P1.count_ListOfBlocks_eq_alternateSum
statement:
lemma count_ListOfBlocks_eq_alternateSum (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin)
  : List.count Coin.A (listOfBlocks l head) = List.alternateSum l (head = Coin.A)

name: Imo2022P1.indexInBlock_eq_length_sub_one_of
statement:
lemma indexInBlock_eq_length_sub_one_of (l : List ℕ) (hl :l ≠ [])
  (k : ℕ) (hk : l.sum ≤ k + l.getLast hl) (hk' : k < l.sum)
  : indexInBlock l k = l.length - 1

name: Imo2022P1.listOfBlocks_length
statement:
lemma listOfBlocks_length (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin)
  : (listOfBlocks l head).length = l.sum

name: Imo2022P1.ofFn_ofBlocks
statement:
lemma ofFn_ofBlocks {n : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) (head : Coin) (hl : l.sum = 2 * n)
  : List.ofFn (Row.ofBlocks l head hl) = listOfBlocks l head

name: Imo2022P1.segments_getElem?_map_eq
statement:
lemma segments_getElem?_map_eq (l : List Coin) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (List.segments l).length)

name: Imo2022P5.mylemma_3
statement:
lemma mylemma_3
  (a b p : ℕ)
  (hp : Nat.Prime p)
  (h₁ : a ^ p = b.factorial + p)
  (hbp : p ≤ b) :
  (p ∣ a)

statement:

    (h₀ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b)
    (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (h₁ : a ^ p = b.factorial + p)
    (hbp : p ≤ b)
    (h₂ : p ∣ a)
    (hb2p : b < 2 * p) :

    (p : ℕ)
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) :

name: Imo2023P3.Fpoly_coeff_bound
statement:
lemma Fpoly_coeff_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A) (m j : ℕ) :
    |(Fpoly P A k m).coeff j| ≤ (1 + k * Csum P k) ^ k + Csum P k

name: Imo2023P3.backward_bounded
statement:
lemma backward_bounded {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A)
    {B : ℕ} (hB : ∀ m, A m ≤ B) :
    ∃ a₀ d : ℕ, ∀ m, A m = a₀ + d * m

    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) :
    ∃ a₀ d : ℕ, ∀ m, A m = a₀ + d * m

name: Imo2023P3.backward_unbounded
statement:
lemma backward_unbounded {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A)
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : ∀ m, m ≥ N₀ → (k * ((1 + k * Csum P k) ^ k + Csum P k) : ℤ) < A m) :
    ∃ a₀ d : ℕ, ∀ m, A m = a₀ + d * m

    0 ≤ (X + C c : ℤ[X]).coeff j

name: Imo2023P3.coeff_prod_linear_bound
statement:
lemma coeff_prod_linear_bound {S : ℤ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) (σ : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∀ (s : Finset ℕ), (∀ i ∈ s, |σ i| ≤ S) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, |(∏ i ∈ s, (X + C (σ i))).coeff j| ≤ (1 + S) ^ s.card

name: Imo2023P3.degree_prod_linear
statement:
lemma degree_prod_linear {σ : ℕ → ℤ} (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, (X + C (σ i))).degree = (s.card : WithBot ℕ)

name: Imo2023P3.diff_eventually_const
statement:
lemma diff_eventually_const {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A)
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : ∀ m, m ≥ N₀ → (k * ((1 + k * Csum P k) ^ k + Csum P k) : ℤ) < A m) :
    ∃ m c, (∀ j ≥ m, Dif A j = c)

name: Imo2023P3.diff_le
statement:
lemma diff_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A) (m : ℕ) :
    A (m + 1) ≤ A m + (Csum P k).toNat

name: Imo2023P3.eval_eq
statement:
lemma eval_eq {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (x : ℤ) :
    P.eval x = x ^ k + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, P.coeff j * x ^ j

name: Imo2023P3.eval_lower
statement:
lemma eval_lower {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {x : ℤ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : x ^ k ≤ P.eval x

name: Imo2023P3.eval_pos
statement:
lemma eval_pos {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {x : ℤ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < P.eval x

name: Imo2023P3.eval_strictMono
statement:
lemma eval_strictMono {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {x y : ℤ} (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x < y) :
    P.eval x < P.eval y

name: Imo2023P3.eval_sum_eq
statement:
lemma eval_sum_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < A m) (hmono : Monotone A)
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : ∀ m, m ≥ N₀ → (k * ((1 + k * Csum P k) ^ k + Csum P k) : ℤ) < A m)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≥ N₀) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ) = k * (A m : ℤ) + P.coeff (k - 1)

name: Imo2023P3.eval_upper
statement:
lemma eval_upper {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {x : ℤ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : P.eval x ≤ x ^ k + Csum P k * x ^ (k - 1)

name: Imo2023P3.hA_of
statement:
lemma hA_of {k : ℕ} {P : Polynomial ℤ} {a : ℕ+ → ℕ+}
    (hP : ∀ n : ℕ+, P.eval ((a n) : ℤ) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, a ⟨n + i + 1, Nat.succ_pos _⟩) (m : ℕ) :
    P.eval (seqA a m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (seqA a (m + 1 + i) : ℤ)

name: Imo2023P3.key_recurrence
statement:
lemma key_recurrence {k : ℕ} {P : Polynomial ℤ} {A : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))
    (m : ℕ) :
    (A (m + 1 + k) : ℤ) * P.eval (A m : ℤ) = (A (m + 1) : ℤ) * P.eval (A (m + 1) : ℤ)

name: Imo2023P3.shift_bounds
statement:
lemma shift_bounds {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hmon : P.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.degree = k) (hcoef : ∀ n, n ≤ k → 0 ≤ P.coeff n)
    {A : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : ∀ m, P.eval (A m : ℤ) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (A (m + 1 + i) : ℤ))

name: Imo2023P5.S_lower
statement:
lemma S_lower (j : JapaneseTriangle n) (i : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
      Nat.log 2 i * i + 2 * (i - 2 ^ Nat.log 2 i) + 1 ≤
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.range i, f j i p

name: Imo2023P5.S_rec
statement:
lemma S_rec (j : JapaneseTriangle n) {i : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i) (hin : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ p ∈ Finset.range i, f j i p) + (∑ p ∈ Finset.range i, f j i p + (i - 1)) / i + 1 ≤
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), f j (i + 1) p

lemma card_reds_le (P : NinjaPath n) (j : JapaneseTriangle n) :

statement:

    1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ∀ p, p < i →

statement: lemma f_eq_zero_of_le (j : JapaneseTriangle n) {i p : ℕ} (h : i ≤ p) : f j i p = 0

name: Imo2023P5.f_succ
statement:
lemma f_succ (j : JapaneseTriangle n) (i p : ℕ) :

lemma pathPos_splice_gt (P : NinjaPath n) {i p q : ℕ} (hpi : p ≤ i) (hi : 1 ≤ i)

    pathPos (splicePath P i p q hpi hi hin hP hstep) k = p

name: Imo2023P5.pathPos_splice_le
statement:
lemma pathPos_splice_le (P : NinjaPath n) {i p q : ℕ} (hpi : p ≤ i) (hi : 1 ≤ i)
    (hin : i ≤ n) (hP : pathPos P i = q) (hstep : q = p ∨ q + 1 = p) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n) (hki : k ≤ i) :
    pathPos (splicePath P i p q hpi hi hin hP hstep) k = pathPos P k

name: Imo2023P5.redsUpto_succ
statement:
lemma redsUpto_succ (P : NinjaPath n) (j : JapaneseTriangle n) (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) :
    redsUpto P j (i + 1) = redsUpto P j i +
      (if redPos j (i + 1) = pathPos P (i + 1) then 1 else 0)

name: Imo2025P5.bazza_invariant
statement:
lemma bazza_invariant {c : ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (hc : c ≤ Real.sqrt 2 / 2)
    (hgreedy : ∀ j, Odd j → x j = Real.sqrt ((j : ℝ) + 1 - ∑ i ∈ range j, x i ^ 2)) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ m < 2 * k, ValidAt c x m) →
      ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k), x i ^ 2 = 2 * (k : ℝ) ∧
        Real.sqrt 2 * k ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k), x i

name: Imo2025P5.bazza_step
statement:
lemma bazza_step {c : ℝ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} (hc : c ≤ Real.sqrt 2 / 2) {k : ℕ}
    (hb : x (2 * k + 1) =
      Real.sqrt (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 - ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k + 1), x i ^ 2))
    (hQ : ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k), x i ^ 2 = 2 * (k : ℝ))
    (hS : Real.sqrt 2 * k ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k), x i)
    (hv : ValidAt c x (2 * k)) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (2 * k + 1), x i ^ 2 = 2 * (k : ℝ) + x (2 * k) ^ 2 ∧
      0 ≤ x (2 * k + 1) ∧ x (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 = 2 - x (2 * k) ^ 2

statement:
lemma find_cut (θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (n : ℝ) * θ = 180 →
    ∀ a b c : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 < c → a + b + c = 180 →
    (¬∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ (a = (k : ℝ) * θ ∨ b = (k : ℝ) * θ ∨ c = (k : ℝ) * θ)) →
    ∃ A B C : ℝ, ∃ m : ℕ, ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℝ) = {A, B, C} ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧
      C < (m : ℝ) * θ ∧ (m : ℝ) * θ < 180 - B

    (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : ℤ, y ≠ (k : ℝ) * θ) → IsCut s L R →
    (L.sum = 180 ∧ ∀ y ∈ L, ∀ k : ℤ, y ≠ (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨
    (R.sum = 180 ∧ ∀ y ∈ R, ∀ k : ℤ, y ≠ (k : ℝ) * θ)

name: Usa1974P4.probFirstAB_eq
statement:
lemma probFirstAB_eq (win : Player → Player → ℝ)
    (hBA : win .B .A = 1 - win .A .B) (hCA : win .C .A = 1 - win .A .C)
    (hCB : win .C .B = 1 - win .B .C) :
    probFirstAB win =
      win .A .B * win .A .C + win .A .B * (1 - win .A .C) * win .B .C * win .A .B +
        (1 - win .A .B) * (1 - win .B .C) * win .A .C * win .A .B

    (hCB : win .C .B = 1 - win .B .C) :
    probFirstAC win =
      win .A .C * win .A .B + win .A .C * (1 - win .A .B) * (1 - win .B .C) * win .A .C +
        (1 - win .A .C) * win .B .C * win .A .B * win .A .C

name: Usa1974P4.probFirstBC_eq
statement:

    (hCB : win .C .B = 1 - win .B .C) :
    probFirstBC win =
      win .B .C * win .A .B * win .A .C + (1 - win .B .C) * win .A .C * win .A .B

name: Usa1984P4.card_attempters
statement:
lemma card_attempters {Pupil : Type} [Fintype Pupil] (attempt : Pupil → Finset (Fin 28))
    (hattempt : ∀ p, (attempt p).card = 7)
    (hpair : ∀ q1 q2 : Fin 28, q1 ≠ q2 →
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p ↦ q1 ∈ attempt p ∧ q2 ∈ attempt p).card = 2)
    (q : Fin 28) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p ↦ q ∈ attempt p).card = 9

name: Usa1984P4.card_ordered_pairs
statement:
lemma card_ordered_pairs (s : Finset (Fin 28)) :
    ∑ q1 : Fin 28, ∑ q2 : Fin 28, (if q1 ∈ s ∧ q2 ∈ s ∧ q1 ≠ q2 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      = s.card * (s.card - 1)

name: Usa1984P4.card_pupils
statement:
lemma card_pupils {Pupil : Type} [Fintype Pupil] (attempt : Pupil → Finset (Fin 28))
    (hattempt : ∀ p, (attempt p).card = 7)
    (hpair : ∀ q1 q2 : Fin 28, q1 ≠ q2 →
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p ↦ q1 ∈ attempt p ∧ q2 ∈ attempt p).card = 2) :
    Fintype.card Pupil = 36

name: Usa1984P4.sum_ite_erase
statement:
lemma sum_ite_erase (s : Finset (Fin 28)) (q1 : Fin 28) :
    ∑ q2 : Fin 28, (if q1 ∈ s ∧ q2 ∈ s ∧ q1 ≠ q2 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      = if q1 ∈ s then s.card - 1 else 0

name: Usa1984P4.sum_pupils_pair
statement:
lemma sum_pupils_pair {Pupil : Type} [Fintype Pupil] (attempt : Pupil → Finset (Fin 28))
    (hpair : ∀ q1 q2 : Fin 28, q1 ≠ q2 →
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p ↦ q1 ∈ attempt p ∧ q2 ∈ attempt p).card = 2)
    (q1 q2 : Fin 28) :
    (∑ p : Pupil, if q1 ∈ attempt p ∧ q2 ∈ attempt p ∧ q1 ≠ q2 then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
      = if q1 ≠ q2 then 2 else 0

name: Usa1984P4.sum_two_distinct
statement:
lemma sum_two_distinct (q1 : Fin 28) :
    ∑ q2 : Fin 28, (if q1 ≠ q2 then (2 : ℕ) else 0) = 54

name: Usa1984P5.fwdDiff_iter_zero
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_iter_zero (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    fwdDiff^[m] f 0 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (m - j) * (m.choose j : ℝ) * f j

name: Usa1984P5.poly_fwdDiff
statement:
lemma poly_fwdDiff (m : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.natDegree < m) (k : ℕ) :
    fwdDiff^[m] (fun j ↦ P.eval (j : ℝ)) k = 0

Usa1985P4.answer_card
statement:
lemma answer_card (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (p : Fin n × Fin n)
    (hp : p ∈ Finset.offDiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun X => X ≠ p.1 ∧ X ≠ p.2 ∧ (G.Adj X p.1 ↔ G.Adj X p.2)).card =
      (n - 2) - (badPair n G p).card

name: Usa1985P4.badPair_eq_bipartiteBelow
statement:
lemma badPair_eq_bipartiteBelow (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    badPair n G p = Finset.univ.bipartiteBelow (mixedRel n G) p

name: Usa1985P4.degree_le
statement:
lemma degree_le (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (X : Fin n) :
    G.degree X ≤ n - 1

name: Usa1985P4.double_count
statement:
lemma double_count (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    (∑ p ∈ Finset.offDiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), (badPair n G p).card) =
      ∑ X : Fin n, 2 * (G.degree X * (n - 1 - G.degree X))

name: Usa1985P4.exists_pair_le
statement:
lemma exists_pair_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    ∃ p ∈ Finset.offDiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
      (badPair n G p).card ≤ (n - 1) / 2

name: Usa1985P4.fiber_card
statement:
lemma fiber_card (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (X : Fin n) :
    ((Finset.offDiag Finset.univ).bipartiteAbove (mixedRel n G) X).card =
      2 * (G.degree X * (n - 1 - G.degree X))

name: Usa1985P4.neighborFinset_subset_erase
statement:
lemma neighborFinset_subset_erase (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

name: Usa1985P4.two_mul_sum_badPair_le

lemma two_mul_sum_badPair_le (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :

    (h : (7 ∣ a + 2 * j₁ ∧ 7 ∣ a + 2 * j₂) ∨

name: Usa1986P1.not_all_divisible
statement:
lemma not_all_divisible (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ j < 7, ¬ 3 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧ ¬ 5 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧
             ¬ 7 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧ ¬ 11 ∣ a + 2 * j

name: Usa1986P1.not_all_divisible_of_three
statement:
lemma not_all_divisible_of_three (t₁ t₂ t₃ : ℕ) (a : ℕ)
    (h₁₂ : t₁ ≠ t₂) (h₁₃ : t₁ ≠ t₃) (h₂₃ : t₂ ≠ t₃)
    (b₁ : t₁ < 7) (b₂ : t₂ < 7) (b₃ : t₃ < 7)
    (s₁ : ¬ 3 ∣ a + 2 * t₁ ∧ ¬ 5 ∣ a + 2 * t₁)
    (s₂ : ¬ 3 ∣ a + 2 * t₂ ∧ ¬ 5 ∣ a + 2 * t₂)
    (s₃ : ¬ 3 ∣ a + 2 * t₃ ∧ ¬ 5 ∣ a + 2 * t₃) :
    ∃ j < 7, ¬ 3 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧ ¬ 5 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧
             ¬ 7 ∣ a + 2 * j ∧ ¬ 11 ∣ a + 2 * j

name: Usa1986P2.F_asleep
statement:
lemma F_asleep
    (hsleep : ∀ p q : Fin 5, p ≠ q → ∃ t, Asleep s e p t ∧ Asleep s e q t)
    (A : PairSet) {p : Fin 5} (hp : p ∈ A.1) : Asleep s e p (F hsleep A)

name: Usa1986P2.F_mem
statement:
lemma F_mem
    (hsleep : ∀ p q : Fin 5, p ≠ q → ∃ t, Asleep s e p t ∧ Asleep s e q t)
    (A : PairSet) : ∃ p ∈ A.1, ∃ k : Fin 2, F hsleep A = s p k

name: Usa1986P2.cands_nonempty
statement:
lemma cands_nonempty
    (hsleep : ∀ p q : Fin 5, p ≠ q → ∃ t, Asleep s e p t ∧ Asleep s e q t)
    {A : Finset (Fin 5)} (hA : A.card = 2) : (cands s e A).Nonempty

statement:

    (ht : ∀ p ∈ A, Asleep s e p t) : ∃ u ∈ cands s e A, u ≤ t

name: Usa1986P2.f_asleep
statement:
lemma f_asleep {A : Finset (Fin 5)} {h : (cands s e A).Nonempty} :

name: Usa1986P2.f_le
statement:
lemma f_le {A : Finset (Fin 5)} (hA : A.Nonempty) {h : (cands s e A).Nonempty}
    {t : ℝ} (ht : ∀ p ∈ A, Asleep s e p t) : f s e A h ≤ t

name: Usa1986P2.f_mem
statement:
lemma f_mem {A : Finset (Fin 5)} {h : (cands s e A).Nonempty} :
    ∃ p ∈ A, ∃ k : Fin 2, f s e A h = s p k

name: Usa1986P2.mem_cands
statement:
lemma mem_cands {A : Finset (Fin 5)} {u : ℝ} :
    u ∈ cands s e A ↔
      (∃ p ∈ A, ∃ k : Fin 2, s p k = u) ∧ ∀ p ∈ A, Asleep s e p u

name: Usa1986P5.card_partitions_containing

lemma card_partitions_containing (n m : ℕ) (h1 : 1 ≤ m) (h2 : m ≤ n) :
    Fintype.card { p : Nat.Partition n // m ∈ p.parts } = numPartitions (n - m)

name: Usa1986P5.sum_count_one
statement:
lemma sum_count_one (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p : Nat.Partition n, p.parts.count 1 =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, numPartitions k

name: Usa1986P5.sum_count_one_succ
statement:
lemma sum_count_one_succ (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p : Nat.Partition (n + 1), p.parts.count 1 =
      ∑ p : Nat.Partition n, p.parts.count 1 + numPartitions n

name: Usa1986P5.sum_distinct_parts
statement:
lemma sum_distinct_parts (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p : Nat.Partition n, p.parts.toFinset.card =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, numPartitions k

name: Usa1987P3.InX.eval_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma InX.eval_mem_Ioo {r : Polynomial ℝ} (hr : InX r)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    0 < r.eval x ∧ r.eval x < 1

name: Usa1987P3.InX.trichotomy
statement:
lemma InX.trichotomy {r : Polynomial ℝ} (hr : InX r) :
    ∀ {s : Polynomial ℝ}, InX s →
      r = s ∨ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → r.eval x < s.eval x) ∨
              (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → s.eval x < r.eval x)

name: Usa1987P5.T_alt
statement: lemma T_alt (k : ℕ) : numGoodTriples (altSeq (2 * k + 1)) = (2 * k + 1) * k.choose 2

name: Usa1987P5.altSeq_eq_iff
statement: lemma altSeq_eq_iff {i j : Fin n} : altSeq n i = altSeq n j ↔ (i : ℕ) % 2 = (j : ℕ) % 2

name: Usa1987P5.card_eqBefore_alt
statement:
lemma card_eqBefore_alt (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * k + 1)) :
    (eqBefore (altSeq (2 * k + 1)) i).card = (i : ℕ) / 2

name: Usa1987P5.card_neqAfter_alt
statement:
lemma card_neqAfter_alt (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * k + 1)) :
    (neqAfter (altSeq (2 * k + 1)) i).card = k - (i : ℕ) / 2

name: Usa1987P5.card_tripsA
statement:
lemma card_tripsA (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    (tripsA a).card = ∑ k : Fin n, ((eqBefore a k).card).choose 2

name: Usa1987P5.card_tripsB
statement:
lemma card_tripsB (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    (tripsB a).card = ∑ j : Fin n, (eqBefore a j).card * (neqAfter a j).card

name: Usa1987P5.card_tripsC
statement:
lemma card_tripsC (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    (tripsC a).card = ∑ i : Fin n, ((neqAfter a i).card).choose 2

name: Usa1987P5.choose_add_two
statement: lemma choose_add_two (x y : ℕ) : (x + y).choose 2 = x.choose 2 + y.choose 2 + x * y

name: Usa1987P5.f_alt
statement: lemma f_alt (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 * k + 1)) : f (altSeq (2 * k + 1)) i = k

name: Usa1987P5.f_apply
statement:
lemma f_apply (a : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) :
    f a i = (eqBefore a i).card + (neqAfter a i).card

name: Usa1987P5.good_iff
statement:
lemma good_iff (x y z : Bool) :
    ¬ ((x = false ∧ y = true ∧ z = false) ∨ (x = true ∧ y = false ∧ z = true)) ↔
      x = y ∨ y = z

name: Usa1987P5.lower_bound
statement:
lemma lower_bound (k : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * k + 1) → Bool) :
    (2 * k + 1) * k.choose 2 ≤ numGoodTriples a

name: Usa1987P5.numGoodTriples_eq
statement:
lemma numGoodTriples_eq (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    numGoodTriples a = (tripsA a).card + (tripsB a).card + (tripsC a).card

name: Usa1987P5.sum_eqBefore
statement:
lemma sum_eqBefore (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (eqBefore a i).card =
      ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n ↦
        p.1 < p.2 ∧ a p.1 = a p.2).card

name: Usa1987P5.sum_f
statement:
lemma sum_f (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, f a i = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card.choose 2

name: Usa1987P5.sum_neqAfter
statement:
lemma sum_neqAfter (a : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (neqAfter a i).card =
      ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n ↦
        p.1 < p.2 ∧ a p.1 ≠ a p.2).card

name: Usa1988P1.not_ten_dvd_num
statement:
lemma not_ten_dvd_num {a b s : ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hab : a % 10 ≠ b % 10) :
    ¬ 10 ∣ a * (10 ^ s - 1) + b

name: Usa1988P2.vieta
statement:
lemma vieta (a b c r s t : ℝ)
    (h : (X - C r) * (X - C s) * (X - C t) = X ^ 3 + C a * X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c) :
    a = -(r + s + t) ∧ b = r * s + s * t + t * r

name: Usa1988P3.card_bad_pairs_le
statement:
lemma card_bad_pairs_le (X : Finset ℕ) (f : Finset ℕ → ℕ) :
    ((X.powersetCard 10).sigma
        (fun Y ↦ Y.filter (fun k ↦ f (Y.erase k) = k))).card
      ≤ (X.powersetCard 9).card

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_comp_X_sq
statement:
lemma coeff_comp_X_sq (q : ℚ[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    (q.comp (X ^ 2)).coeff (2 * j) = q.coeff j

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_comp_neg_X
statement:
lemma coeff_comp_neg_X (p : ℚ[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (p.comp (-X)).coeff n = (-1) ^ n * p.coeff n

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_mul_two
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_two (f g : ℚ[X]) :
    (f * g).coeff 2 =
      f.coeff 0 * g.coeff 2 + f.coeff 1 * g.coeff 1 + f.coeff 2 * g.coeff 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_one_factor
statement:
lemma coeff_one_factor {n a : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((1 - X ^ n) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 1 = 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_one_one_sub_X
statement: lemma coeff_one_one_sub_X (a : ℕ) : ((1 - X) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 1 = -(a : ℚ)

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_one_prod
statement:
lemma coeff_one_prod (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ[X])
    (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 0 = 1) (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 1 = 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).coeff 1 = 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_one_sub_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_one_sub_pow (n a k : ℕ) :
    ((1 - X ^ n) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff k =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a + 1),
        if j * n = k then (-1 : ℚ) ^ j * (a.choose j : ℚ) else 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_two_factor
statement:
lemma coeff_two_factor {n a : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ((1 - X ^ n) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 2 = 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_two_one_sub_X
statement:
lemma coeff_two_one_sub_X (a : ℕ) :
    ((1 - X) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 2 = (a.choose 2 : ℚ)

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_two_one_sub_X_sq
statement:
lemma coeff_two_one_sub_X_sq (a : ℕ) :
    ((1 - X ^ 2) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 2 = -(a : ℚ)

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_two_prod
statement:
lemma coeff_two_prod (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ[X])
    (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 0 = 1) (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 1 = 0)
    (h2 : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).coeff 2 = 0) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).coeff 2 = 0

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_zero_factor
statement:
lemma coeff_zero_factor {n a : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_zero_one_sub_X
statement: lemma coeff_zero_one_sub_X (a : ℕ) : ((1 - X) ^ a : ℚ[X]).coeff 0 = 1

name: Usa1988P5.coeff_zero_prod

    {C C₁ : ℕ}

    (hC₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → |a m| ≤ (C₁ : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) ^ N)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * N < m)

statement:
lemma gcd_lcm_dvd_prod_gcd (t : ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < t i) → Nat.gcd (s.lcm t) x ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, Nat.gcd (t i) x

name: Usa1995P4.gcd_lcm_le_pow
statement:
lemma gcd_lcm_le_pow (m N j : ℕ) (hm : N < m) (hj : j ∈ Finset.range N) :
    Nat.gcd ((Finset.range (j + 1)).lcm (fun i => m - i)) (m - (j + 1)) ≤ N ^ (j + 1)

name: Usa1995P4.interpolate_exists
statement:
lemma interpolate_exists (a : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℚ[X], q.natDegree ≤ N ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ N → q.eval (i : ℚ) = (a i : ℚ)

name: Usa1995P4.prod_eq_lcm_mul_gcd_prod
statement:
lemma prod_eq_lcm_mul_gcd_prod (t : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), t i =
      (Finset.range (k + 1)).lcm t *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, Nat.gcd ((Finset.range (j + 1)).lcm t) (t (j + 1))

name: Usa1995P4.prod_le_lcm_mul_pow
statement:
lemma prod_le_lcm_mul_pow (N m : ℕ) (hm : N < m) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (m - i) ≤
      ((Finset.range (N + 1)).lcm fun i => m - i) * N ^ (N * (N + 1))

name: Usa1995P4.sum_pow_abs_le
statement:
lemma sum_pow_abs_le (c : ℕ → ℤ) (N : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c i * (m : ℤ) ^ i| ≤
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (c i).natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) ^ N

name: Usa1995P5.card_far_add_sum_degree
statement:
lemma card_far_add_sum_degree (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (P : Fin n) :
    #(G.edgeFinset.filter fun e => ∀ v ∈ e, ¬G.Adj P v)
      + ∑ Q ∈ G.neighborFinset P, G.degree Q = #G.edgeFinset

name: Usa1995P5.not_adj_and_adj_of_mem_edgeFinset
statement:
lemma not_adj_and_adj_of_mem_edgeFinset (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) {P Q₁ Q₂ : Fin n}
    (hPQ₁ : G.Adj P Q₁) (hPQ₂ : G.Adj P Q₂) (hne : Q₁ ≠ Q₂)
    {e : Sym2 (Fin n)} (he : e ∈ G.edgeFinset) (h₁ : Q₁ ∈ e) (h₂ : Q₂ ∈ e) :
    False

name: Usa1995P5.sum_degree_neighborFinset_eq_card
statement:
lemma sum_degree_neighborFinset_eq_card (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (P : Fin n) :
    ∑ Q ∈ G.neighborFinset P, G.degree Q

name: Usa1995P5.sum_sum_degree_neighborFinset

lemma sum_sum_degree_neighborFinset :

name: Usa1996P2.prefixSum_card

name: Usa1996P2.prefixSum_succ

lemma prefixSum_succ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < S.card) :

name: Usa1996P2.prefixSum_succ_lt_two_mul_sum

name: Usa1996P2.sum_eq_sum_filter

name: Usa1996P2.sum_eq_sum_univ

name: Usa1996P4.pattern_transfer
statement:
theorem pattern_transfer {n : ℕ} {y : Fin (n + 1) → Bool} {x : Fin n → Bool}
    (hxe : ∀ j : ℕ, j < n → xor (sget y j) (sget y (j + 1)) = sget x j)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 3 < n + 1) :
    ((sget y i = false ∧ sget y (i + 1) = false ∧ sget y (i + 2) = true ∧
        sget y (i + 3) = true) ∨
      (sget y i = true ∧ sget y (i + 1) = true ∧ sget y (i + 2) = false ∧
        sget y (i + 3) = false)) ↔
    (sget x i = false ∧ sget x (i + 1) = true ∧ sget x (i + 2) = false)

name: Usa1997P1.rat_cast_of_seq
statement:
lemma rat_cast_of_seq (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ k, 0 < p k) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ q : ℚ, seq p x₀ k = (q : ℝ)) → ∃ q : ℚ, x₀ = (q : ℝ)
  | 0, h => h
  | k + 1, h => rat_cast_of_seq p hp x₀ k (rat_cast_of_seq_succ p hp x₀ k h)

name: Usa1997P1.rat_cast_of_seq_succ

name: Usa1997P1.seq_shift
statement:
lemma seq_shift (p : ℕ → ℕ) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, seq (fun n ↦ p (n + 1)) (seq p x₀ 1) k = seq p x₀ (k + 1)
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [seq_succ (fun n ↦ p (n + 1)) (seq p x₀ 1) k, seq_shift p x₀ k,
      seq_succ p x₀ (k + 1)]

name: Usa1997P3.step_props
statement:
lemma step_props (u v : ℤ) (h3 : (u - v) % 3 = 0) :
    0 ≤ digit u v ∧ digit u v ≤ 9 ∧
    2 * ((digit u v - u) / 2) = digit u v - u ∧
    5 * ((digit u v - v) / 5) = digit u v - v ∧
    ((digit u v - u) / 2 - (digit u v - v) / 5) % 3 = 0 ∧
    (2 < v.natAbs → ((digit u v - v) / 5).natAbs < v.natAbs) ∧
    (v.natAbs ≤ 2 → 9 < u.natAbs → ((digit u v - u) / 2).natAbs < u.natAbs) ∧
    (v.natAbs ≤ 2 → ((digit u v - v) / 5).natAbs ≤ 2)

    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

name: Usa1999P3.Sw_mul_sub_one

name: Usa1999P3.alg_symm
statement:
lemma alg_symm {x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ : ℂ} (h₁ : x₁ ≠ 1) (h₂ : x₂ ≠ 1) (h₃ : x₃ ≠ 1) (h₄ : x₄ ≠ 1)
    (h : 1 / (x₁ - 1) + 1 / (x₂ - 1) + 1 / (x₃ - 1) + 1 / (x₄ - 1) = -2) :
    2 + (x₁ * x₂ * x₃ + x₁ * x₂ * x₄ + x₁ * x₃ * x₄ + x₂ * x₃ * x₄)
      = x₁ + x₂ + x₃ + x₄ + 2 * (x₁ * x₂ * x₃ * x₄)

name: Usa1999P3.chi_add
statement:
lemma chi_add {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (j k : ZMod p) :
    chi p (j + k) = chi p j * chi p k

name: Usa1999P3.chi_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma chi_eq_one_iff {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (j : ZMod p) : chi p j = 1 ↔ j = 0

name: Usa1999P3.chi_zero
statement: lemma chi_zero (p : ℕ) : chi p (0 : ZMod p) = 1

name: Usa1999P3.sum_chi

lemma sum_chi {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : 2 < p) (c : ZMod p) :
    ∑ m : ZMod p, chi p (c * m) = if c = 0 then (p : ℂ) else 0

name: Usa1999P3.sum_chi_self

name: Usa1999P3.sum_zmod_val

name: Usa1999P4.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonpos

name: Usa1999P5.threat_shapes
statement:
lemma threat_shapes {b : Board} (hTF : ThreatFree b) {x : ℕ}
    (hx : x < 2000) (hxe : b x = none) {l₀ : Piece}
    (h : HasThreat (Function.update b x (some l₀))) :
    (l₀ = Piece.O ∧ 1 ≤ x ∧ b (x - 1) = none ∧ b (x + 1) = some Piece.S) ∨
    (l₀ = Piece.O ∧ 1 ≤ x ∧ b (x + 1) = none ∧ b (x - 1) = some Piece.S) ∨
    (l₀ = Piece.S ∧ b (x + 2) = some Piece.S ∧ b (x + 1) = none) ∨
    (l₀ = Piece.S ∧ 2 ≤ x ∧ b (x - 2) = some Piece.S ∧ b (x - 1) = none) ∨
    (l₀ = Piece.S ∧ 2 ≤ x ∧ b (x - 1) = some Piece.O ∧ b (x - 2) = none) ∨
    (l₀ = Piece.S ∧ b (x + 1) = some Piece.O ∧ b (x + 2) = none)

name: Usa2000P3.fewestWays_rec
statement:
lemma fewestWays_rec (A B C : ℕ) (h : 0 < A + B + C) :
    fewestWays A B C =
      (if 0 < A ∧ lowestScore A B C = A * C then fewestWays (A - 1) B C else 0) +
      (if 0 < B ∧ lowestScore A B C = 3 * A * B then fewestWays A (B - 1) C else 0) +
      (if 0 < C ∧ lowestScore A B C = 2 * B * C then fewestWays A B (C - 1) else 0)

name: Usa2000P3.tight_red

name: Usa2000P6.kernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem kernel_nonneg {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (u w z : ι → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ u i) (hw : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, z i * z j * min (u i * w j) (u j * w i)

name: Usa2000P6.key_identity
statement:
theorem key_identity (a b c d : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    min (a * d) (c * b) - min (a * c) (b * d) =
      (if b ≤ a then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (if d ≤ c then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        min (min a b * |c - d|) (min c d * |a - b|)

name: Usa2000P6.min_kernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem min_kernel_nonneg {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (z : ι → ℝ) :
    ∀ (T : Finset ι) (s : ι → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ T, 0 ≤ s i) →
      0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, ∑ j ∈ T, z i * z j * min (s i) (s j)

name: Usa2002P3.card_roots_and_splits
statement:
theorem card_roots_and_splits {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hn : p.natDegree = n)
    (hmul : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i + 1 ≤ n →
      p.eval (i : ℝ) * p.eval ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < 0)
    (htail : (∃ a₁ : ℝ, a₁ < 1 ∧ p.eval a₁ * p.eval 1 < 0) ∨
             (∃ a₂ : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < a₂ ∧ p.eval (n : ℝ) * p.eval a₂ < 0)) :
    p.roots.card = n ∧ p.Splits

name: Usa2002P3.card_roots_eq_n
statement:
theorem card_roots_eq_n {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hn : p.natDegree = n)
    {ξ : ℕ → ℝ} (hinj : Set.InjOn ξ (Finset.range n))
    (hroot : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, p.eval (ξ i) = 0) :
    p.roots.card = n ∧ p.Splits

name: Usa2002P3.card_roots_eq_n_of_intervals

theorem card_roots_eq_n_of_intervals {p : ℝ[X]} {n : ℕ} (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hn : p.natDegree = n)
    {L R : ℕ → ℝ} (hstep : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → R i ≤ L (i + 1))
    (hex : ∀ i, i < n → ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (L i) (R i), p.eval x = 0) :
    p.roots.card = n ∧ p.Splits

name: Usa2005P1.isChain_append
statement:
lemma isChain_append {α : Type*} {R' : α → α → Prop} : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α),
    l₁.IsChain R' → l₂.IsChain R' →
    (∀ a ∈ l₁.getLast?, ∀ b ∈ l₂.head?, R' a b) → (l₁ ++ l₂).IsChain R'
  | [], l₂, _, h₂, _ => by simpa using h₂
  | [a], [], _, _, _ => by simp [List.IsChain.singleton]
  | [a], b :: t, _, h₂, h => .cons_cons (h a (by simp) b (by simp)) h₂
  | a :: b :: s, l₂, h₁, h₂, h =>
      .cons_cons (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp h₁).1
        (isChain_append (b :: s) l₂ (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp h₁).2 h₂ (by simpa using h))

name: Usa2005P1.isChain_flatMap_powChain
statement:
lemma isChain_flatMap_powChain {q e : ℕ} :
    ∀ {l : List ℕ}, l.IsChain R → (∀ x ∈ l, 2 ≤ x) →
      (l.flatMap (fun d => powChain d q e)).IsChain R ∧
      ((l.flatMap (fun d => powChain d q e)).head? = l.head?) ∧
      ((l.flatMap (fun d => powChain d q e)).getLast? =
        (l.getLast?).map (fun d => d * q ^ e))
  | [], _, _ => by simp
  | [d], _, h2 =>
      ⟨by simpa using isChain_powChain (h2 d (by simp)) e, by simp, by simp⟩
  | d₁ :: d₂ :: t, hchain, h2 => by
    have hd₁ : 2 ≤ d₁

name: Usa2005P1.isChain_of_forall_dvd
statement:
lemma isChain_of_forall_dvd {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∀ {l : List ℕ}, (∀ x ∈ l, r ∣ x) → l.IsChain R
  | [], _ => .nil
  | [a], _ => .singleton a
  | a :: b :: t, h =>
      .cons_cons (R_of_dvd_of_dvd hr (h a (by simp)) (h b (by simp)))

name: Usa2007P3.main
statement:
lemma main (col : Finset α → Bool) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ S : Finset α, S.card = k * (n + 1) - 1 →
      ∃ F : Finset (Finset α), k ≤ F.card ∧ (∀ A ∈ F, A ⊆ S ∧ A.card = n) ∧
        (F : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id ∧ ∃ b : Bool, ∀ A ∈ F, col A = b

name: Usa2008P5.euclid
statement:
lemma euclid : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (r : Fin 3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (p q : ℕ),
    p + q = n → (∀ l, 0 ≤ r l) → 0 < t → i ≠ j → 0 < p → 0 < q →
    r i = (p : ℝ) * t → r j = (q : ℝ) * t →
    ∃ r' : Fin 3 → ℝ, Relation.ReflTransGen Step r r' ∧ ∃ l, r' l = 0

name: Usa2008P5.key
statement:
lemma key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (r : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3 → ℤ),
    weight a = n → (∀ l, 0 ≤ r l) → a ≠ 0 → (∑ l, (a l : ℝ) * r l) = 0 →
    ∃ r' : Fin 3 → ℝ, Relation.ReflTransGen Step r r' ∧ ∃ l, r' l = 0

name: Usa2008P5.move_lemma
statement:
lemma move_lemma {r : Fin 3 → ℝ} {a : Fin 3 → ℤ} {i j k : Fin 3}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hnn : ∀ l, 0 ≤ r l) (hle : r k ≤ r i)
    (hsum : (a i : ℝ) * r i + (a j : ℝ) * r j + (a k : ℝ) * r k = 0)
    (hane : a i ≠ 0) (hdec : (a k + a i).natAbs < (a k).natAbs) :
    ∃ r' : Fin 3 → ℝ, Step r r' ∧ (∀ l, 0 ≤ r' l) ∧
      ∃ a' : Fin 3 → ℤ, a' ≠ 0 ∧
        (a' i : ℝ) * r' i + (a' j : ℝ) * r' j + (a' k : ℝ) * r' k = 0 ∧
        (a' i).natAbs + (a' j).natAbs + (a' k).natAbs <
          (a i).natAbs + (a j).natAbs + (a k).natAbs

name: Usa2008P5.phase1_core
statement:
lemma phase1_core {r : Fin 3 → ℝ} {a : Fin 3 → ℤ} {i j k : Fin 3}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hrj : r j < r i) (hrk : r k < r j) (hpos : ∀ l, 0 < r l)
    (hai : a i ≠ 0) (haj : a j ≠ 0) (hak : a k ≠ 0)
    (hsum : (a i : ℝ) * r i + (a j : ℝ) * r j + (a k : ℝ) * r k = 0) :
    ∃ r' : Fin 3 → ℝ, Step r r' ∧ (∀ l, 0 ≤ r' l) ∧
      ∃ a' : Fin 3 → ℤ, a' ≠ 0 ∧ (∑ l, (a' l : ℝ) * r' l = 0) ∧ weight a' < weight a

    (hrj : r j < r i) (hrk : r k < r j) (hpos : ∀ l, 0 < r l)
    (hai : 0 < a i) (haj : a j ≠ 0) (hak : a k ≠ 0)

name: Usa2008P5.sum3
Usa2008P5.weight_eq_three

name: Usa2010P2.alternation
statement:
lemma alternation {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (a b : Fin n) (hab : a.val + 2 ≤ b.val)
    (ha : a.val + 1 < n) :
    ∀ (e : Fin n ≃ ZMod n) (ps : List (ZMod n)), Legal e ps →
      (StateA e a b (fsucc a ha) →
        (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) + 1 ∧
        (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (a, b)) ∧
      (¬ StateA e a b (fsucc a ha) →
        (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ∧
        (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) + 1)

statement:
lemma stateA_swap_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {a b c : Fin n} {e : Fin n ≃ ZMod n} {p : ZMod n}
    (hc : c.val = a.val + 1) (hab : a.val + 2 ≤ b.val) (hcb : c.val < b.val)
    (hleg : (e.symm p).val + 2 ≤ (e.symm (p + 1)).val)
    (hJ : (e.symm p, e.symm (p + 1)) ≠ (a, b))
    (hM : (e.symm p, e.symm (p + 1)) ≠ (c, b)) :

name: Usa2010P3.constr_even

lemma constr_ineq {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) :

name: Usa2010P3.ineq_ee

    (4 * p + 3) / (2 * Real.sqrt (p + 1)) * ((4 * q + 3) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q + 1)))
      ≤ (2 * p + 1) + (2 * q + 1)

name: Usa2010P3.ineq_eo
statement:
lemma ineq_eo {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) :

      ≤ (2 * p + 1) + (2 * q + 2)

statement:
lemma ineq_oe {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p + 1 ≤ q) :
    (2 * Real.sqrt (p + 1)) * ((4 * q + 3) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q + 1)))
      ≤ (2 * p + 2) + (2 * q + 1)

name: Usa2010P3.ineq_oo
statement:
lemma ineq_oo {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :

    ∃ a : ℕ → ℤ, (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → a i ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (j + 1 : ℤ) * a ((j + 1) * k) = 0

name: Usa2012P3.sum_mulSeq_cfun_sub_one
statement:
lemma sum_mulSeq_cfun_sub_one {n p q : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hp5 : 5 ≤ p) (hq7 : 7 ≤ q) (hplt : p < q)
    (h2q : n < 2 * q) (h4p : n < 4 * p) (hpn : p ≤ n) (hqn : q ≤ n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (j : ℤ) * (mulSeq {p, q} (cfun p q x y) j - 1)
      = (p : ℤ) * (x - 1)
        + (if 2 * p ≤ n then ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ) * (x - 1) else 0)
        + (if 3 * p ≤ n then ((3 * p : ℕ) : ℤ) * (x - 1) else 0)
        + (q : ℤ) * (y - 1)

name: Usa2013P3.card_range4

lemma card_range4 (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :

        (if P 2 then 1 else 0) + (if P 3 then 1 else 0)

name: Usa2013P3.pair_weight

    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (ε1, false, τ))) +
      weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (ε1, true, τ))) = 2 * bv v.x ε1 τ + 2 * n

name: Usa2013P3.pon_eval
statement:
lemma pon_eval {n : ℕ} (F : Fin n → Bool) (P : ℕ → Bool) (hF : ∀ i, F i = P i.val)
    (hP : ∀ i, P (i + 4) = P i) {k r s : ℕ} (hk : n = 4 * k + r) (hn2 : n % 2 = s) :
    pon F = k * (((Finset.range 4).filter fun i => ((P i && !decide (i % 2 = s))) = true).card) +
      (((Finset.range r).filter fun i => ((P i && !decide (i % 2 = s))) = true).card)

statement: lemma pon_le {n : ℕ} (α : Fin n → Bool) : pon α ≤ Ocard n

name: Usa2013P3.qon_eval

    (hP : ∀ i, P (i + 4) = P i) {k r s : ℕ} (hk : n = 4 * k + r) (hn2 : n % 2 = s) :
    qon F = k * (((Finset.range 4).filter fun i => ((P i && decide (i % 2 = s))) = true).card) +
      (((Finset.range r).filter fun i => ((P i && decide (i % 2 = s))) = true).card)

name: Usa2013P3.sp_vxor
statement:
lemma sp_vxor {n : ℕ} (ε ε' : Bool × Bool × Bool) :
    Moves.vxor (sp n ε) (sp n ε') =
      sp n (ε.1 ^^ ε'.1, ε.2.1 ^^ ε'.2.1, ε.2.2 ^^ ε'.2.2)

name: Usa2013P3.sum_weights
statement:
lemma sum_weights {n : ℕ} (v : Moves n) :
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, false, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, false, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, true, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, true, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, false, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, false, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, true, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, true, true))) = 12 * n

name: Usa2016P2.sum_add_div_le
statement:
lemma sum_add_div_le (k q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (j + k) / q ≤ k ^ 2 / q + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, j / q

name: Usa2016P2.sum_range_period

lemma sum_range_period {q : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℕ} (hF : ∀ j, F (j + q) = F j) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (a * q + b), F j =

name: Usa2016P2.sum_range_period_mul

name: Usa2016P2.sum_range_period_shift

    {S Q : Finset (Fin (2 * n))} (hS : S.card = n) (hQ : Q.card = n)

name: Usa2016P6.slideStrat_of_ge
statement:
lemma slideStrat_of_ge {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    {hist : List (Observation n)} (h : 2 * n < hist.length + k)
    (h₂ : ∃ p q : Fin (2 * n - k), p ≠ q ∧
      labelAt n k hist p.val = labelAt n k hist q.val) :
    slideStrat n k hk hkn hist =
      pairSet n k hk (le_of_lt hkn) h₂.choose h₂.choose_spec.choose
        h₂.choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: Usa2016P6.slide_arr_frozen
statement:
lemma slide_arr_frozen {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (W : Wizard n) (hW : W.Valid)
    (hM : ¬ (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).won)
    (x : Fin (2 * n)) (hx : x.val < 2 * n - k)
    (j : ℕ) (hj1 : x.val + 1 ≤ j) (hj2 : j ≤ 2 * n - k + 1) :
    (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).arr x =
      (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (x.val + 1)).arr x

name: Usa2016P6.slide_arr_step
statement:
lemma slide_arr_step {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (W : Wizard n) (hW : W.Valid)
    (hM : ¬ (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).won)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 * n - k + 1) :
    (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (j + 1)).arr =
      (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).arr ∘
        W.perm (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist (window n k j)

name: Usa2016P6.slide_labelAt_eq
statement:
lemma slide_labelAt_eq {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (W : Wizard n) (hW : W.Valid)
    (hM : ¬ (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).won)
    (x : Fin (2 * n)) (hx : x.val < 2 * n - k) :
    labelAt n k ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).hist) x.val =
      (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (x.val + 1)).arr x

name: Usa2016P6.slide_play_facts
statement:
lemma slide_play_facts {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (W : Wizard n) (_hW : W.Valid)
    (hM : ¬ (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).won)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * n - k + 1) :
    (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).won = false ∧
    ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist).length = j ∧
    (∀ i (_hi : i < j), ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist)[i]? =
      some (window n k i, reveal ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W i).arr) (window n k i))) ∧
    (∀ j' (_hj' : j' < j),
      ((window n k j').image (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j').arr).card = k)

    qq (eCnt m (m p)) * genFun m 0 =
      qq (n + 1) * (eCnt m (m p) : ℤ[X]) * genFun (m ∘ skipEmb p) 0

name: Usa2017P2.ainvCount_comp
statement:
lemma ainvCount_comp {n : ℕ} (e : Perm (Fin n)) (m : Fin n → ℤ) (A : Fin n → ℤ)
    (σ : Perm (Fin n)) : ainvCount (m ∘ e) A σ = ainvCount m A (e * σ)

name: Usa2017P2.ainvCount_decompose
statement:
lemma ainvCount_decompose {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (A : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ)
    (p : Fin (n + 1)) (π : Perm (Fin n)) :
    ainvCount m A (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, π)) =
      frontContrib (A 0) (m p) (m ∘ skipEmb p) + ainvCount (m ∘ skipEmb p) (A ∘ Fin.succ) π
