name: Usa2017P2.eCnt_eq_card_filter
statement:
lemma eCnt_eq_card_filter {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → ℤ) (v : ℤ) :
    eCnt m v = (univ.filter (fun i => m i = v)).card

name: Usa2017P2.exists_perm_of_valMul_eq
statement:
lemma exists_perm_of_valMul_eq {n : ℕ} :
    ∀ {m₁ m₂ : Fin n → ℤ}, valMul m₁ = valMul m₂ → ∃ e : Perm (Fin n), m₂ = m₁ ∘ e

name: Usa2017P2.exists_skipEmb_eq
statement:
lemma exists_skipEmb_eq {n : ℕ} {p q : Fin (n + 1)} (h : p ≠ q) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, skipEmb q i = p

name: Usa2017P2.frontContrib_eval
Usa2017P2.frontContrib_gt
statement:
lemma frontContrib_gt {t : ℕ} (c x : ℤ) (w : Fin t → ℤ) (h : c < x) :
    frontContrib c x w = ∑ ℓ : Fin t, if c < w ℓ ∧ w ℓ < x then 1 else 0

name: Usa2017P2.frontContrib_le
statement:
lemma frontContrib_le {t : ℕ} (c x : ℤ) (w : Fin t → ℤ) (h : x ≤ c) :
    frontContrib c x w =
      (∑ ℓ : Fin t, if w ℓ < x then 1 else 0) + ∑ ℓ : Fin t, if c < w ℓ then 1 else 0

name: Usa2017P2.genFun_comp
statement:
lemma genFun_comp {n : ℕ} (e : Perm (Fin n)) (m : Fin n → ℤ) (A : Fin n → ℤ) :
    genFun (m ∘ e) A = genFun m A

name: Usa2017P2.genFun_eq_of_valMul_eq
statement:
lemma genFun_eq_of_valMul_eq {n : ℕ} {m₁ m₂ : Fin n → ℤ} (h : valMul m₁ = valMul m₂)
    (A : Fin n → ℤ) : genFun m₁ A = genFun m₂ A

name: Usa2017P2.genFun_one
statement: lemma genFun_one (m : Fin 1 → ℤ) (A : Fin 1 → ℤ) : genFun m A = 1

name: Usa2017P2.genFun_rec
statement:
lemma genFun_rec {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (A : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    genFun m A = ∑ p : Fin (n + 1),
      X ^ frontContrib (A 0) (m p) (m ∘ skipEmb p) * genFun (m ∘ skipEmb p) (A ∘ Fin.succ)

name: Usa2017P2.genFun_skipEmb_congr
Usa2017P2.genFun_zero
statement: lemma genFun_zero (m : Fin 0 → ℤ) (A : Fin 0 → ℤ) : genFun m A = 1

name: Usa2017P2.image_skipEmb
statement: lemma image_skipEmb {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) : univ.image (skipEmb p) = univ.erase p

name: Usa2017P2.invPair_iff
statement:
lemma invPair_iff (c x y : ℤ) :
    invPair c x y ↔ (y < x ∧ (x ≤ c ∨ c < y)) ∨ (x ≤ y ∧ x ≤ c ∧ c < y)

name: Usa2017P2.list_map_sum_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma list_map_sum_eq_sum_range {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [Inhabited α] [AddCommMonoid β]
    (l : List α) (f : α → β) :
    (l.map f).sum = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range l.length, f l[t]!

name: Usa2017P2.list_sum_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma list_sum_eq_sum_range (l : List ℕ) :
    l.sum = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range l.length, l[t]!

name: Usa2017P2.list_sum_take_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma list_sum_take_eq_sum_range (l : List ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ l.length) :
    (l.take j).sum = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range j, l[t]!

name: Usa2017P2.multiset_card_filter_finset_sum
statement:
lemma multiset_card_filter_finset_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Multiset ℤ) (p : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Multiset.card (Multiset.filter p (∑ v ∈ s, f v)) =
      ∑ v ∈ s, Multiset.card (Multiset.filter p (f v))

name: Usa2017P2.multiset_filter_replicate
statement:
lemma multiset_filter_replicate (p : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (k : ℕ) (v : ℤ) :
    Multiset.filter p (Multiset.replicate k v) = if p v then Multiset.replicate k v else 0

name: Usa2017P2.pureId
statement:
lemma pureId (es : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ es.length) :
    X ^ (es.sum - (es.take k).sum) *
        (∑ t ∈ range k, X ^ (es.take t).sum * qq es[t]!) +
      (∑ t ∈ Ico k es.length, X ^ ((es.take t).sum - (es.take k).sum) * qq es[t]!) =
      qq es.sum

name: Usa2017P2.pureId_value
statement:
lemma pureId_value {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (c : ℤ) :
    ∑ v ∈ univ.image m, X ^ gc m c v * qq (eCnt m v) = qq (n + 1)

name: Usa2017P2.qq_add
statement: lemma qq_add (a b : ℕ) : qq (a + b) = qq a + X ^ a * qq b

name: Usa2017P2.repr_spec
statement:
lemma repr_spec {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) {v : ℤ} (h : ∃ i, m i = v) :
    m (repr m v) = v

name: Usa2017P2.skipEmb_ne
statement: lemma skipEmb_ne {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) : skipEmb p i ≠ p

name: Usa2017P2.sorted_filter_eq_take
statement:
lemma sorted_filter_eq_take (l : List ℤ) (c : ℤ) (hp : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) :
    l.filter (· ≤ c) = l.take (l.filter (· ≤ c)).length

name: Usa2017P2.sorted_getElem!_le_iff
statement:
lemma sorted_getElem!_le_iff {l : List ℤ} (hp : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (hn : l.Nodup)
    (c : ℤ) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < l.length) :
    l[t]! ≤ c ↔ t < (l.filter (· ≤ c)).length

name: Usa2017P2.sorted_getElem!_lt_iff
statement:
lemma sorted_getElem!_lt_iff {l : List ℤ} (hp : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (hn : l.Nodup)
    {s t : ℕ} (hs : s < l.length) (ht : t < l.length) :
    l[s]! < l[t]! ↔ s < t

name: Usa2017P2.sorted_get_lt_iff
statement:
lemma sorted_get_lt_iff {l : List ℤ} (hp : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (hn : l.Nodup)
    (s t : Fin l.length) : l.get s < l.get t ↔ s < t

name: Usa2017P2.sum_eq_sum_image_card
statement:
lemma sum_eq_sum_image_card {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (H : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ[X])
    (K : ℤ → ℤ[X]) (hHK : ∀ q, H q = K (m q)) :
    ∑ q, H q = ∑ v ∈ univ.image m, (eCnt m v : ℤ[X]) * K v

name: Usa2017P2.sum_if_eq_cntP
statement:
lemma sum_if_eq_cntP {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → ℤ) (q : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred q] :
    (∑ i : Fin n, if q (m i) then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = cntP m q

name: Usa2017P2.sum_if_eq_count
statement:
lemma sum_if_eq_count {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → ℤ) (y : ℤ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, if m i = y then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = (valMul m).count y

name: Usa2017P2.sum_image_eq_sort_map_sum
statement:
lemma sum_image_eq_sort_map_sum {n : ℕ} {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) (G : ℤ → β) :
    ∑ v ∈ univ.image m, G v = (((univ.image m).sort (· ≤ ·)).map G).sum

name: Usa2017P2.sum_univ_add_skipEmb
statement:
lemma sum_univ_add_skipEmb {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (p : Fin (n + 1))
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → M) : ∑ i, g i = g p + ∑ i : Fin n, g (skipEmb p i)

name: Usa2017P2.valMul_comp_skipEmb
statement:
lemma valMul_comp_skipEmb {n : ℕ} (m : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    valMul (m ∘ skipEmb p) = (valMul m).erase (m p)

name: Usa2017P2.valMul_eq_sum_eCnt
statement:
lemma valMul_eq_sum_eCnt {n : ℕ} (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    valMul m = ∑ v ∈ univ.image m, eCnt m v • {v}

name: Usa2017P4.arc_rotate
statement:
lemma arc_rotate {a b e : Fin m} (hab : a ≠ b) (h : cdist a b < cdist a e) :
    cdist b e < cdist b a

name: Usa2017P4.avail_insert
statement:
lemma avail_insert (b : Fin m) (used : Finset (Fin m)) :
    avail c (insert b used) = (avail c used).erase b

name: Usa2017P4.card_avail_insert
statement:
lemma card_avail_insert {b : Fin m} {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hb : b ∈ avail c used) :
    (avail c (insert b used)).card = (avail c used).card - 1

name: Usa2017P4.cdist_add_of_lt
statement:
lemma cdist_add_of_lt {a b e : Fin m} (h : cdist a b < cdist a e) :
    cdist a e = cdist a b + cdist b e

name: Usa2017P4.cdist_if
statement:
lemma cdist_if (a b : Fin m) :
    cdist a b = if a.val ≤ b.val then b.val - a.val else b.val + m - a.val

name: Usa2017P4.cdist_left_inj
statement: lemma cdist_left_inj {a b₁ b₂ : Fin m} (h : cdist a b₁ = cdist a b₂) : b₁ = b₂

name: Usa2017P4.cdist_pos
statement: lemma cdist_pos {a b : Fin m} (h : a ≠ b) : 0 < cdist a b

name: Usa2017P4.mem_avail
statement:
lemma mem_avail {used : Finset (Fin m)} {b : Fin m} :
    b ∈ avail c used ↔ c b = false ∧ b ∉ used

name: Usa2017P4.nb_eq_choose
statement:
lemma nb_eq_choose {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty) :
    nb c used r = Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image (avail c used) (cdist r) h)

name: Usa2017P4.nb_eq_of
statement:
lemma nb_eq_of {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r b : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty)
    (hb : b ∈ avail c used) (hmin : ∀ q ∈ avail c used, cdist r b ≤ cdist r q) :
    nb c used r = b

name: Usa2017P4.nb_mem
statement:
lemma nb_mem {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty) :
    nb c used r ∈ avail c used

name: Usa2017P4.nb_min
statement:
lemma nb_min {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty)
    {q : Fin m} (hq : q ∈ avail c used) :
    cdist r (nb c used r) ≤ cdist r q

name: Usa2017P4.shift_cdist
statement: lemma shift_cdist (a b : Fin m) : shift a (cdist a b) = b

name: Usa2017P4.wrap_eq_of_mem_arc
statement:
lemma wrap_eq_of_mem_arc {y x p : Fin m} (hpy : p ≠ y) (h : cdist y p < cdist y x) :
    wrap p y = wrap p x + (if y.val < x.val then 1 else 0)

name: Usa2017P4.wraps_cons
statement:
lemma wraps_cons (r : Fin m) (rs : List (Fin m)) (used : Finset (Fin m)) :
    wraps c (r :: rs) used =
      wrap r (nb c used r) + wraps c rs (insert (nb c used r) used)

name: Usa2017P4.wraps_perm
statement:
lemma wraps_perm {l₁ l₂ : List (Fin m)} (h : List.Perm l₁ l₂) :
    (∀ r ∈ l₁, c r = true) → ∀ used : Finset (Fin m),
      l₁.length ≤ (avail c used).card → wraps c l₁ used = wraps c l₂ used

name: Usa2017P4.wraps_swap_pair
statement:
lemma wraps_swap_pair {r r' : Fin m} (hr : c r = true) (hr' : c r' = true)
    {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hcard : 2 ≤ (avail c used).card) :
    wrap r (nb c used r) + wrap r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') =
      wrap r' (nb c used r') + wrap r (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) ∧
    insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') (insert (nb c used r) used) =
      insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) (insert (nb c used r') used)

name: Usa2017P5.dist_lt
statement:
lemma dist_lt {p : ℤ × ℤ} {l : ℤ × ℤ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hp : 2 * n + 1 ≤ l p) (a : (Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ) × Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ)))
  (ha : |a.1.val| < 2 ^ n ∨ |a.2.val| < 2 ^ n)
  : dist p (p + ((a.1 : ℤ), (a.2 : ℤ))) < √2 ^ l p

name: Usa2017P5.dist_lt'
statement:
lemma dist_lt' {p : ℤ × ℤ} {l : ℤ × ℤ → ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hp : l p = 2 * (n + 1)) (a : (Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ) × Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ)))
  : dist p (p + ((a.1 : ℤ), (a.2 : ℤ))) < √2 ^ l p

name: Usa2017P5.dist_ne
statement: lemma dist_ne {p₁ p₂ : ℤ × ℤ} (h : p₁ ≠ p₂) : 1 ≤ dist p₁ p₂

name: Usa2017P5.dist_scale
statement: lemma dist_scale {a b c d : ℤ} : dist (a * 2, b * 2) (c * 2, d * 2) = dist (a, b) (c, d) * 2

name: Usa2017P5.exclusion
statement:
lemma exclusion {l : ℤ × ℤ → ℕ} (l_dist : ∀ {p1 p2}, p1 ≠ p2 → (l p1 = l p2) → √2 ^ (l p1) ≤ dist p1 p2)
  {n : ℕ} {a : (Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ) × Finset.Icc (-2 ^ n : ℤ) (2 ^ n : ℤ))} {p : ℤ × ℤ}
  (ha₂ : dist p (p + ((a.1 : ℤ), (a.2 : ℤ))) < √2 ^ l p) (ha₁ : a ≠ (⟨0, by simp⟩, ⟨0, by simp⟩))
  : l (p + (a.1.val, a.2.val)) ≠ l p

name: Usa2017P5.label_cases
statement: lemma label_cases : label (limit + 1) p = 1 ∨ label (limit + 1) p = 2 ∨ label (limit + 1) p = 2 + label limit (p.1 / 2, p.2 / 2)

name: Usa2017P5.label_congr
statement:
lemma label_congr {limit : ℕ} {p₁ p₂ : ℤ × ℤ} (h : label (limit + 1) p₁ = label (limit + 1) p₂)
  : (Odd (p₁.1 + p₁.2) ∧ Odd (p₂.1 + p₂.2))
    ∨ (Odd p₁.1 ∧ Odd p₁.2 ∧ Odd p₂.1 ∧ Odd p₂.2)
    ∨ (Even p₁.1 ∧ Even p₁.2 ∧ Even p₂.1 ∧ Even p₂.2)

name: Usa2017P5.label_dist
Usa2017P5.label_dist_max
Usa2017P5.label_finite
statement: lemma label_finite : (Set.range <| label limit).Finite

name: Usa2017P5.label_max
statement: lemma label_max : label limit p ≤ 2 * limit + 1

name: Usa2017P5.label_max_exists_eq
statement: lemma label_max_exists_eq (h : label limit p = 2 * limit + 1) : ∃ a b : ℤ, p = (a * 2 ^ limit, b * 2 ^ limit)

name: Usa2017P5.label_more_iff
statement: lemma label_more_iff : label (limit + 1) p = 2 + label limit (p.1 / 2, p.2 / 2) ↔ Even p.1 ∧ Even p.2

name: Usa2017P5.label_one_iff
statement: lemma label_one_iff : label (limit + 1) p = 1 ↔ Odd (p.1 + p.2)

name: Usa2017P5.label_pos
statement: lemma label_pos : 0 < label limit p

name: Usa2017P5.label_two_iff
statement: lemma label_two_iff : label (limit + 1) p = 2 ↔ Odd p.1 ∧ Odd p.2

name: Usa2017P5.square_squeeze'
statement:
lemma square_squeeze' (n : ℕ) (l : labelling √2)
  : ∃ p : Finset.range (2 ^ n) × Finset.range (2 ^ n), 2 * n < l p

name: Usa2017P6.one_direction
statement: lemma one_direction : ∃ x, Conditions x ∧ f x = 2 / 3

name: Usa2017P6.other_direction
statement: lemma other_direction {x} (hx : Conditions x) : 2 / 3 ≤ f x

name: Usa2018P1.am_gm
statement:
lemma am_gm (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    2 * (a * b) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ a + b

name: Usa2018P2.arg_pos
statement: theorem arg_pos {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) : 0 < 1 / s - 1

name: Usa2018P2.backward
statement:
theorem backward {f : ℝ → ℝ} {k : ℝ} (hk : k ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1)
    (hf : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → f t = k / (t + 1) + (1 - k) / 3) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x) ∧
    (∀ x y z : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → 0 < z → x * y * z = 1 →
      f (x + 1 / y) + f (y + 1 / z) + f (z + 1 / x) = 1)

name: Usa2018P2.f_formula
statement:
theorem f_formula {k l : ℝ} (hsum : k + 3 * l = 1)
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → g f x = k * x + l)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : f t = k / (t + 1) + (1 - k) / 3

name: Usa2018P2.f_lt_one
statement: theorem f_lt_one {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : f t < 1

name: Usa2018P2.forward
statement:
theorem forward :
    ∃ k : ℝ, k ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → f t = k / (t + 1) + (1 - k) / 3

name: Usa2018P2.g_eq
statement:
theorem g_eq {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    g f (a / (a + b + c)) + g f (b / (a + b + c)) + g f (c / (a + b + c)) = 1

name: Usa2018P2.g_eq_one
statement:
theorem g_eq_one {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hsum : a + b + c = 1) : g f a + g f b + g f c = 1

name: Usa2018P2.g_jensen
statement:
theorem g_jensen {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b < 1) :
    g f a + g f b = 2 * g f ((a + b) / 2)

name: Usa2018P2.g_linear
statement:
theorem g_linear {k l : ℝ} (hsum : k + 3 * l = 1)
    (hmid : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 8 ≤ x → x ≤ 3 / 8 → g f x = k * x + l)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) : g f x = k * x + l

name: Usa2018P2.g_linear_ext_high
statement:
theorem g_linear_ext_high {k l : ℝ} (hsum : k + 3 * l = 1)
    (hmid : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 8 ≤ x → x ≤ 3 / 8 → g f x = k * x + l)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 3 / 8 ≤ x) (hx1 : x < 1) : g f x = k * x + l

name: Usa2018P2.g_linear_ext_low
Usa2018P2.g_linear_low
Usa2018P2.g_linear_mid_exp
statement:
theorem g_linear_mid_exp {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 1 / 8 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 3 / 8) :
    g f x = 4 * (g f (3 / 8) - g f (1 / 8)) * x + (3 * g f (1 / 8) - g f (3 / 8)) / 2

name: Usa2018P2.g_lt_one
statement: theorem g_lt_one {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) : g f s < 1

name: Usa2018P2.g_pos
statement: theorem g_pos {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) : 0 < g f s

name: Usa2018P2.hfn_bdd
statement: theorem hfn_bdd {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : |hfn f t| ≤ 1

name: Usa2018P2.hfn_eq_zero
statement: theorem hfn_eq_zero {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : hfn f t = 0

name: Usa2018P2.hfn_jensen
statement:
theorem hfn_jensen {s t : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    hfn f ((s + t) / 2) = (hfn f s + hfn f t) / 2

name: Usa2018P2.hfn_one
statement: theorem hfn_one : hfn f 1 = 0

name: Usa2018P2.hfn_zero
statement: theorem hfn_zero : hfn f 0 = 0

name: Usa2018P2.jensen_bounded_eq_zero
statement:
theorem jensen_bounded_eq_zero {h : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hJ : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → h ((s + t) / 2) = (h s + h t) / 2)
    (h0 : h 0 = 0) (h1 : h 1 = 0)
    (hb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → |h t| ≤ 1) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → h t = 0

name: Usa2018P2.k_mem
statement:
theorem k_mem {k l : ℝ} (hsum : k + 3 * l = 1)
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → g f x = k * x + l) : k ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1

name: Usa2018P2.kl_nonneg
statement:
theorem kl_nonneg {k l : ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → g f x = k * x + l) : 0 ≤ k + l

name: Usa2018P2.kl_sum
statement:
theorem kl_sum {k l : ℝ}
    (hmid : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 8 ≤ x → x ≤ 3 / 8 → g f x = k * x + l) : k + 3 * l = 1

name: Usa2018P2.l_nonneg
statement:
theorem l_nonneg {k l : ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < 1 → g f x = k * x + l) : 0 ≤ l

name: Usa2018P3.add_mul_inj
statement:
lemma add_mul_inj {n a h a' h' : ℕ} (ha : a < n) (ha' : a' < n)
    (heq : a + n * h = a' + n * h') : a = a' ∧ h = h'

name: Usa2018P3.coprimeSet_card
statement: lemma coprimeSet_card (n : ℕ) : (coprimeSet n).card = n.totient

name: Usa2018P3.coprime_mod_left'

name: Usa2018P3.padicValNat_totient_mul_prime_of_dvd

lemma padicValNat_totient_mul_prime_of_dvd {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hqd : q ∣ n) :
    padicValNat p (Nat.totient (n * q)) = padicValNat p (Nat.totient n)

name: Usa2018P3.padicValNat_totient_mul_prime_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma padicValNat_totient_mul_prime_of_not_dvd {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hqd : ¬ q ∣ n) :
    padicValNat p (Nat.totient (n * q)) =
      padicValNat p (Nat.totient n) + padicValNat p (q - 1)

name: Usa2018P3.powSum_mul_prime_of_dvd
statement:
lemma powSum_mul_prime_of_dvd {n q : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hq : q.Prime) (hqd : q ∣ n) (k : ℕ) :
    powSum (n * q) k = ∑ a ∈ coprimeSet n, ∑ h ∈ Finset.range q, (a + n * h) ^ k

name: Usa2018P3.powSum_mul_prime_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma powSum_mul_prime_of_not_dvd {n q : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hq : q.Prime) (hqd : ¬ q ∣ n) (k : ℕ) :
    powSum (n * q) k + q ^ k * powSum n k =
      ∑ a ∈ coprimeSet n, ∑ h ∈ Finset.range q, (a + n * h) ^ k

name: Usa2018P3.pow_pred_dvd_sum_pow_Icc
statement:
lemma pow_pred_dvd_sum_pow_Icc {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∀ c : ℕ, 1 ≤ c → ∀ t : ℕ, p ^ c ∣ t → ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j →
      p ^ (c - 1) ∣ ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 t, h ^ j

name: Usa2018P3.sum_add_pow_eq
statement:
lemma sum_add_pow_eq (n q k : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ coprimeSet n, ∑ h ∈ Finset.range q, (a + n * h) ^ k =
      q * powSum n k + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
        (k.choose (j + 1)) * (n ^ (j + 1) * powSum n (k - (j + 1)) *
          ∑ h ∈ Finset.range q, h ^ (j + 1))

name: Usa2018P3.sum_range_pow_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
lemma sum_range_pow_eq_sum_Icc (q j : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ Finset.range q, h ^ (j + 1) = ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), h ^ (j + 1)

lemma switch_mapsTo_nums {n : ℕ} {σ φ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (hφ : IsSwitch σ φ) {x : Fin n} (hx : x ∈ nums σ) : φ x ∈ nums σ

name: Usa2018P6.switch_rho_fix_of_mem_ab
statement:
lemma switch_rho_fix_of_mem_ab {n : ℕ} {σ ψ₁ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} (hσ : Function.Involutive σ)
    {a b : Fin n} (ha : a ∈ nums σ) (hb : b ∈ nums σ) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hψ₁ : IsSwitch (rho σ a b) ψ₁) {x : Fin n} (hx : x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset (Fin n))) :
    ψ₁ x = x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.card_e_le_one
statement:
theorem card_e_le_one {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 ≠ 0)
    (hinv : Function.Involutive σ)
    (hcard : (Finset.univ.filter fun y => σ y = y).card ≤ 1) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin n =>
        restrictPerm (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2
          (invol_decomposeFin_symm σ h0 hinv).2 y = y).card ≤ 1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.card_extend_le_one
statement:
theorem card_extend_le_one {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (hτ : Function.Involutive τ)
    (hcard : (Finset.univ.filter fun y => τ y = y).card ≤ 1) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin (n + 2) =>
        Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, extendPerm j τ) y = y).card ≤ 1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.card_fp_restrictPerm
statement:
theorem card_fp_restrictPerm {n : ℕ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hej : e j = j) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin n => restrictPerm e hej y = y).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin (n + 1) => x ≠ j ∧ e x = x).card

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.card_fp_symm_succ
statement:
theorem card_fp_symm_succ {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (he : Function.Involutive e) (hej : e j = j) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin (n + 2) =>
        Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, e) y = y).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin (n + 1) => x ≠ j ∧ e x = x).card

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.card_le_one_symm_zero_iff
statement:
theorem card_le_one_symm_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin (n + 2) =>
        Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (0, e) y = y).card ≤ 1 ↔
      ∀ x : Fin (n + 1), e x ≠ x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.decomposeFin_eq_symm_partner
statement:
theorem decomposeFin_eq_symm_partner {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 ≠ 0) :
    σ = Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm ((partner σ h0).succ, (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2)

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.decomposeFin_eq_symm_zero
statement:
theorem decomposeFin_eq_symm_zero {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 = 0) :
    σ = Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (0, (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2)

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.decomposeFin_fst
statement:
theorem decomposeFin_fst {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) :
    (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).1 = σ 0

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.extendPerm_apply_ne
statement:
theorem extendPerm_apply_ne {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    {x : Fin (n + 1)} (hx : x ≠ j) :
    extendPerm j τ x =
      ((finSuccAboveEquiv j) (τ ((finSuccAboveEquiv j).symm ⟨x, hx⟩))).1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.extendPerm_apply_self
statement:
theorem extendPerm_apply_self {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    extendPerm j τ j = j

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.extendPerm_fix_iff
statement:
theorem extendPerm_fix_iff {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    {x : Fin (n + 1)} (hx : x ≠ j) :
    extendPerm j τ x = x ↔
      τ ((finSuccAboveEquiv j).symm ⟨x, hx⟩) = (finSuccAboveEquiv j).symm ⟨x, hx⟩

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.extendPerm_involutive
statement:
theorem extendPerm_involutive {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) {τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (hτ : Function.Involutive τ) : Function.Involutive (extendPerm j τ)

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.extendPerm_restrictPerm
statement:
theorem extendPerm_restrictPerm {n : ℕ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hej : e j = j) : extendPerm j (restrictPerm e hej) = e

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fcard_one
statement: theorem fcard_one : fcard 1 = 0

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fcard_parity
statement: theorem fcard_parity (n : ℕ) : (Even n → Odd (fcard n)) ∧ (Odd n → fcard n = 0)

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fcard_succ_succ
statement: theorem fcard_succ_succ (n : ℕ) : fcard (n + 2) = (n + 1) * fcard n

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fcard_zero
statement: theorem fcard_zero : fcard 0 = 1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fp_symm_zero
statement:
theorem fp_symm_zero {n : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (y : Fin (n + 2)) :
    Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (0, e) y = y ↔
      y = 0 ∨ ∃ x : Fin (n + 1), y = x.succ ∧ e x = x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fpf_e
statement:
theorem fpf_e {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 ≠ 0)
    (hinv : Function.Involutive σ) (hfpf : ∀ x, σ x ≠ x) :
    ∀ x : Fin (n + 1), x ≠ partner σ h0 → (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2 x ≠ x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fpf_e0
statement:
theorem fpf_e0 {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 = 0)
    (hcard : (Finset.univ.filter fun y => σ y = y).card ≤ 1) :
    ∀ x : Fin (n + 1), (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2 x ≠ x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fpf_extendPerm
statement:
theorem fpf_extendPerm {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) {τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (hτ : ∀ y, τ y ≠ y) : ∀ x : Fin (n + 1), x ≠ j → extendPerm j τ x ≠ x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fpf_restrictPerm
Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.fpf_symm_succ
statement:
theorem fpf_symm_succ {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (he : Function.Involutive e) (hej : e j = j) :
    (∀ y : Fin (n + 2), Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, e) y ≠ y) ↔
      ∀ x : Fin (n + 1), x ≠ j → e x ≠ x

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.invol_decomposeFin_symm
statement:
theorem invol_decomposeFin_symm {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 ≠ 0)
    (hinv : Function.Involutive σ) :
    Function.Involutive (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2 ∧
      (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2 (partner σ h0) = partner σ h0

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.invol_e0
statement:
theorem invol_e0 {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 = 0)
    (hinv : Function.Involutive σ) : Function.Involutive (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin σ).2

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.involutive_symm_succ
statement:
theorem involutive_symm_succ {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) :
    Function.Involutive (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, e)) ↔
      Function.Involutive e ∧ e j = j

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.involutive_symm_zero
statement:
theorem involutive_symm_zero {n : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) :
    Function.Involutive (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (0, e)) ↔ Function.Involutive e

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.partner_succ
statement:
theorem partner_succ {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) (h0 : σ 0 ≠ 0) :
    (partner σ h0).succ = σ 0

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.partner_symm_succ
statement:
theorem partner_symm_succ {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (h0 : (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, e)) 0 ≠ 0) :
    partner (Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (j.succ, e)) h0 = j

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.restrictPerm_apply
statement:
theorem restrictPerm_apply {n : ℕ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hej : e j = j) (y : Fin n) :
    ((finSuccAboveEquiv j) (restrictPerm e hej y)).1 = e ((finSuccAboveEquiv j) y).1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.restrictPerm_extendPerm
statement:
theorem restrictPerm_extendPerm {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    restrictPerm (extendPerm j τ) (extendPerm_apply_self j τ) = τ

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.restrictPerm_fix_iff
statement:
theorem restrictPerm_fix_iff {n : ℕ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hej : e j = j) (y : Fin n) :
    restrictPerm e hej y = y ↔ e ((finSuccAboveEquiv j) y).1 = ((finSuccAboveEquiv j) y).1

name: Usa2018P6.usa2018p6_aux.restrictPerm_involutive
statement:
theorem restrictPerm_involutive {n : ℕ} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (he : Function.Involutive e) (hej : e j = j) :
    Function.Involutive (restrictPerm e hej)

name: Usa2019P1.lemma_1
statement:
lemma lemma_1
    (f : ℕ+ → ℕ+)
    (hf : ∀ n, f^[f n] n * f (f n) = n ^ 2)
    (a b : ℕ+)
    (r : ℕ)
    (fab1 : f^[r] b = a)

    (m : ℕ+)
    (hm1 : f^[2] m = f^[f m] m)
    (hm2 : f^[f m] m = m)
    (hm3 : Odd m.val) :
    f m = m

lemma lemma_3

theorem digits_ten_pow_sub_one (s : ℕ) :

theorem ofDigits_flatMap_digits_pad {E : ℕ} (b : ℕ → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, b i < 10 ^ E) (n : ℕ) :

        Nat.digits 10 (b i) ++ List.replicate (E - (Nat.digits 10 (b i)).length) 0)

name: Usa2019P4.card_between
statement:
lemma card_between {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {A C : Finset α} (hAC : A ⊆ C)
    {t : ℕ} (hAt : A.card ≤ t) :
    Nat.card {X : Finset α // A ⊆ X ∧ X ⊆ C ∧ X.card = t} =
      (C.card - A.card).choose (t - A.card)

name: Usa2019P4.cell_ext
statement:
lemma cell_ext {n : ℕ} {c : Cell n} {a b : ℕ} {ha : a < n + 1} {hb : b < n + 1} :
    c = (⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩) ↔ c.1.val = a ∧ c.2.val = b

name: Usa2019P4.extend_mem
statement:
lemma extend_mem {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Cell n)} {s : Cell n} (hs : s ∉ D)
    {A C : (Cell n → Finset (Fin (2 * n))) → Finset (Fin (2 * n))}
    (hlo : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, d ≤ s → f d ⊆ A f)
    (hhi : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, s ≤ d → C f ⊆ f d)
    {f : Cell n → Finset (Fin (2 * n))} (hf : f ∈ Fillings n D)
    {X : Finset (Fin (2 * n))} (hXA : A f ⊆ X) (hXC : X ⊆ C f)
    (hXt : X.card = target s) :
    Function.update f s X ∈ Fillings n (insert s D)

name: Usa2019P4.fillings_empty
statement: lemma fillings_empty (n : ℕ) : Fillings n (∅ : Set (Cell n)) = {fun _ ↦ ∅}

name: Usa2019P4.main_count
statement: lemma main_count (n : ℕ) : (Fillings n Set.univ).ncard = (2 * n)! * 2 ^ (n ^ 2)

name: Usa2019P4.ncard_fillings_insert
statement:
lemma ncard_fillings_insert {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Cell n)} {s : Cell n} (hs : s ∉ D)
    {A C : (Cell n → Finset (Fin (2 * n))) → Finset (Fin (2 * n))}
    (hlo : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, d ≤ s → f d ⊆ A f)
    (hhi : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, s ≤ d → C f ⊆ f d)
    (hAs : ∀ g ∈ Fillings n (insert s D), A (Function.update g s ∅) ⊆ g s)
    (hsC : ∀ g ∈ Fillings n (insert s D), g s ⊆ C (Function.update g s ∅))
    (hAC : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, A f ⊆ C f)
    {a₀ c₀ : ℕ}
    (hAcard : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (A f).card = a₀)
    (hCcard : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (C f).card = c₀)
    (hAt : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (A f).card ≤ target s) :
    (Fillings n (insert s D)).ncard =
      (c₀ - a₀).choose (target s - a₀) * (Fillings n D).ncard

name: Usa2019P4.prod_range_self_sub
statement:
theorem prod_range_self_sub (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (n - i) = n !

name: Usa2019P4.prod_range_two_mul_sub_mul
statement:
theorem prod_range_two_mul_sub_mul (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * n - j)) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (n - i)) = (2 * n) !

name: Usa2019P4.restrict_mem
statement:
lemma restrict_mem {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Cell n)} {s : Cell n} (hs : s ∉ D)

    Function.update S s ∅ ∈ Fillings n D

name: Usa2019P4.stageA
statement:
lemma stageA (n : ℕ) : ∀ j, j ≤ n →
    (Fillings n (colZero n j)).ncard = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range j, (2 * n - i)

name: Usa2019P4.stageB
statement:
lemma stageB (n : ℕ) : ∀ i, i ≤ n →
    (Fillings n (colZero n n ∪ topRow n i)).ncard =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range i, (n - j)) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * n - j)

name: Usa2019P4.stageC
statement:
lemma stageC (n : ℕ) : ∀ k, k ≤ n →
    (Fillings n (colZero n n ∪ topRow n n ∪ intCols n k)).ncard =
      2 ^ (n * k) * ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (n - i)) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * n - j))

name: Usa2019P4.stageC_inner
statement:
lemma stageC_inner (n : ℕ) : ∀ r, r ≤ n → ∀ k, k < n →
    (Fillings n (colZero n n ∪ topRow n n ∪ intCols n k ∪ colPart n (k + 1) r)).ncard =
      2 ^ r * (Fillings n (colZero n n ∪ topRow n n ∪ intCols n k)).ncard

name: Usa2019P5.Writable.exists_rep
statement:
theorem Writable.exists_rep {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : m.Coprime n)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hpd : p ∣ m + n)
    {x : ℚ} (hx : Writable m n x) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ x = (a : ℚ) / b ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ a + b ∧ ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ b

name: Usa2019P5.dvd_two_mul_mul_of_dvd
Usa2019P5.exists_odd_prime_dvd

name: Usa2019P6.Fk_coeff

    ((X + C h) ^ k + (X - C h) ^ k - 2 * X ^ k : Polynomial ℂ).coeff (k - 2) =
      (k : ℂ) * ((k : ℂ) - 1) * h ^ 2

name: Usa2019P6.phiPoly_eval
statement:
lemma phiPoly_eval {K : Type*} [Field K] (P : Polynomial K) (x y : K)
    (hxy : 2 * x * y ≠ 1) :
    ((PhiPoly P).map (evalRingHom x)).eval y =
      (2 * x * y - 1) ^ (P.natDegree + 1) *
        Qfun P x y ((x + y) / (2 * x * y - 1))

name: Usa2019P6.qfun_eq_sum
statement:
lemma qfun_eq_sum {K : Type*} [Field K] (P : Polynomial K) (x y z : K) :
    Qfun P x y z = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), P.coeff k *
      (x * x ^ k + y * y ^ k + z * z ^ k -
        x * y * z * ((x - y) ^ k + (y - z) ^ k + (z - x) ^ k))

lemma reach_place {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ × ℕ) :
    ∀ b : Board,
    (∀ i ∈ s, (f i).1 + 1 < n ∧ (f i).2 + 1 < n) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (trominoCells (f i).1 (f i).2) (trominoCells (f j).1 (f j).2)) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ c ∈ trominoCells (f i).1 (f i).2, c ∉ b) →
    Reach n b (b ∪ s.biUnion (fun i ↦ trominoCells (f i).1 (f i).2))

    {a b : ℕ}

    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (a + b + 1)))
    (hp : colorCount color 0 p = a ∨ colorCount color 0 p = a + 1) :
    ∃ A B : Finset (Cell (a + b + 1)),
      A.card = a ∧ B.card = b ∧
      (∀ x ∈ A, color x = 0) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B, color y = 1) ∧

name: Usa2024P2.sum_supersets_by_rank

lemma blockCount_add_mul {m n : ℕ} (c : Necklace m n) (s : ZMod (m * n)) (i q : ℕ) :

name: Usa2024P4.blockCount_add_period
statement:
lemma blockCount_add_period {m n : ℕ} (c : Necklace m n) (s : ZMod (m * n)) (i : ℕ) :

name: Usa2024P4.blockCount_constr
Usa2024P4.blockCount_constr_eq
statement:
lemma blockCount_constr_eq {m n : ℕ} (s' t : ℕ) :
    blockCount (constr m n) ((s' : ℕ) : ZMod (m * n)) t =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, rowRed m n ((s' + t * n + j) % (m * n))

name: Usa2024P4.blockCount_le
statement:
lemma blockCount_le {m n : ℕ} (c : Necklace m n) (s : ZMod (m * n)) (i : ℕ) :

name: Usa2024P4.blockCount_mod
statement:
lemma blockCount_mod {m n : ℕ} (c : Necklace m n) (s : ZMod (m * n)) (x : ℕ) :

name: Usa2024P4.blockCount_shift
statement:
lemma blockCount_shift {m n : ℕ} [NeZero (m * n)] (c : Necklace m n)
    (s : ZMod (m * n)) (i : ℕ) :
    blockCount c s i =
      blockCount c ((s.val % n : ℕ) : ZMod (m * n)) (s.val / n + i)

name: Usa2024P4.rowRed_eq
statement:
lemma rowRed_eq {m n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t a : ℕ) (ha : a < n) :
    rowRed m n (t * n + a) = if n + 1 - m ≤ a ∧ a + t < n then 1 else 0

name: Usa2024P4.rowRed_self
statement:
lemma rowRed_self {m n j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    rowRed m n j = if n + 1 - m ≤ j then 1 else 0

name: Usa2024P4.sum_rowRed
statement:
lemma sum_rowRed {m n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : m ≤ n + 1) {s' t : ℕ}
    (hs : s' < n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, rowRed m n (s' + t * n + j)) =
      if s' + t < n then m - 1 - t else m - 2 - t

name: Usa2024P4.sum_rowRed_last
statement:
lemma sum_rowRed_last {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : m ≤ n + 1) {s' : ℕ}
    (hs : s' < n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, rowRed m n ((s' + (m - 1) * n + j) % (m * n))) =
      s' - (n + 1 - m)

name: Usa2024P6.card_inter_cast
statement:
lemma card_inter_cast {n : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) = ∑ p : Fin n, (if p ∈ A ∧ p ∈ B then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Usa2024P6.card_pairs
statement:
lemma card_pairs {n : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, (if p ∈ B ∧ q ∈ B then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (B.card : ℝ) * ((B.card : ℝ) - 1)

name: Usa2024P6.cntS_pair
statement:
lemma cntS_pair {n ℓ : ℕ} (p q p' q' : Fin n) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpq' : p' ≠ q') :
    ((Finset.powersetCard ℓ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).filter
        (fun B => p ∈ B ∧ q ∈ B)).card =
      ((Finset.powersetCard ℓ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).filter
        (fun B => p' ∈ B ∧ q' ∈ B)).card

name: Usa2024P6.cntS_single
statement:
lemma cntS_single {n ℓ : ℕ} (p q : Fin n) :
    ((Finset.powersetCard ℓ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).filter
        (fun B => p ∈ B)).card =
      ((Finset.powersetCard ℓ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).filter
        (fun B => q ∈ B)).card

name: Usa2024P6.cnt_bridge
statement:
lemma cnt_bridge {n k : ℕ} (s : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n))
    (hAmem : ∀ i, A i ∈ s) (hAinj : Function.Injective A)
    (hAsurj : ∀ B ∈ s, ∃ i, A i = B) (p q : Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p ∈ A i ∧ q ∈ A i)).card =
      (s.filter (fun B => p ∈ B ∧ q ∈ B)).card

name: Usa2024P6.cnt_bridge1
statement:
lemma cnt_bridge1 {n k : ℕ} (s : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n))

    (hAsurj : ∀ B ∈ s, ∃ i, A i = B) (p : Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p ∈ A i)).card =
      (s.filter (fun B => p ∈ B)).card

name: Usa2024P6.diag_count
statement:
lemma diag_count {n : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin n)) :

name: Usa2024P6.exists_perm_eq

name: Usa2024P6.finsetCongr_mem_powersetCard
statement:
lemma finsetCongr_mem_powersetCard {n ℓ : ℕ} (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n))

name: Usa2024P6.lhs_eq_sum_v_sq
statement:
lemma lhs_eq_sum_v_sq {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j : Fin k, x i * x j *
        (((A i ∩ A j).card : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((A i).card : ℝ) / ((A j).card : ℝ)) =
      ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q : Fin n, (vvv x A p q) ^ 2

name: Usa2024P6.pair_filter_eq
statement:
lemma pair_filter_eq {n : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (Finset.univ.sigma (fun p : Fin n => Finset.univ.erase p)).filter
        (fun t => t.1 ∈ B ∧ t.2 ∈ B) = B.sigma (fun p => B.erase p)

name: Usa2024P6.solution_eq
statement:
lemma solution_eq {n ℓ : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) (S : ℝ) :
    solution n ℓ * S ^ 2 =
      S ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) + ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * S ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))

name: Usa2024P6.solution_le_of_works
statement:
lemma solution_le_of_works {n ℓ : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) (hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hℓn : ℓ ≤ n) (c : ℝ)

name: Usa2024P6.solution_works

name: Usa2024P6.sum_diag
statement:
lemma sum_diag {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n))
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).card ≠ 0) :
    ∑ p : Fin n, vvv x A p p = ∑ i : Fin k, x i

name: Usa2024P6.sum_offdiag
statement:
lemma sum_offdiag {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n))
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).card ≠ 0) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.sigma (fun p : Fin n => Finset.univ.erase p), vvv x A t.1 t.2 =
      ∑ i : Fin k, (((A i).card : ℝ) - 1) * x i

name: Usa2024P6.sum_sigma_erase
statement:
lemma sum_sigma_erase {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.sigma (fun p : Fin n => Finset.univ.erase p), f t.1 t.2 =
      ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, f p q

name: Usa2024P6.sum_sq_split
statement:
lemma sum_sq_split {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q : Fin n, (vvv x A p q) ^ 2 =
      (∑ p : Fin n, (vvv x A p p) ^ 2) +
        ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, (vvv x A p q) ^ 2

name: Usa2024P6.sum_swap4
statement:
lemma sum_swap4 {n k : ℕ} (F : Fin k → Fin k → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j : Fin k, ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q : Fin n, F i j p q) =
      ∑ p : Fin n, ∑ q : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j : Fin k, F i j p q

name: Usa2024P6.vvv_def
statement:
lemma vvv_def {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (A : Fin k → Finset (Fin n)) (p q : Fin n) :
    vvv x A p q = ∑ i : Fin k, if p ∈ A i ∧ q ∈ A i then x i / (A i).card else 0

name: Usa2025P1.residue_mod
statement:
lemma residue_mod {n k ℓ : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hℓk : ℓ ≤ k) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, Odd c ∧ 1 ≤ c ∧ n ^ k % (2 * n) ^ ℓ = c * n ^ ℓ

name: Usa2025P2.coeff_iterate_derivative_factor
statement:
lemma coeff_iterate_derivative_factor (F : ℝ[X]) (j m : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, (derivative^[j] F).coeff m = F.coeff (m + j) * N

name: Usa2025P2.core_pigeonhole

lemma core_pigeonhole {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {s : Finset ℝ} (hscard : s.card = k + 1)

name: Usa2025P2.dvd_X_pow_two_iterate_derivative
statement:
lemma dvd_X_pow_two_iterate_derivative (R : ℝ[X]) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)

name: Usa2025P2.good_derivative
Usa2025P2.good_iterate

lemma good_iterate (F : ℝ[X]) (j : ℕ)

lemma natDegree_iterate_derivative_eq (F : ℝ[X]) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ F.natDegree) :

name: Usa2025P2.not_nodup_roots_of_X_pow_two_dvd

name: Usa2025P2.roots_real_aux

lemma roots_real_aux {P : ℝ[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hsq : Squarefree P)

name: Usamo2025P4.angle_lt_pi_div_two_inner_pos
statement:
lemma angle_lt_pi_div_two_inner_pos (p q r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

name: Usamo2025P4.p4_circumcenter
statement:
lemma p4_circumcenter (A B C H F P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hH1 : ⟪H -ᵥ A, C -ᵥ B⟫ = 0)
    (hH2 : ⟪H -ᵥ B, C -ᵥ A⟫ = 0)
    (hFline : F ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({A, B} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))
    (hFperp : ⟪C -ᵥ F, B -ᵥ A⟫ = 0)
    (hPperp : ⟪P -ᵥ H, C -ᵥ B⟫ = 0)
    (hPmid : midpoint ℝ H P ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) :
    dist (Mc A H C) A = dist (Mc A H C) F ∧ dist (Mc A H C) A = dist (Mc A H C) P

name: Usamo2025P4.p4_lin_indep
statement:
lemma p4_lin_indep (A F P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (h : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({A, F, P} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))) :

name: Usamo2025P4.p4_not_collinear
statement:
lemma p4_not_collinear (A B C H F P O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ)
    (htri : AffineIndependent ℝ ![A, B, C])
    (hacuteA : ∠ B A C < Real.pi / 2)
    (hacuteB : ∠ A B C < Real.pi / 2)
    (hacuteC : ∠ B C A < Real.pi / 2)
    (hH1 : ⟪H -ᵥ A, C -ᵥ B⟫ = 0)
    (hH2 : ⟪H -ᵥ B, C -ᵥ A⟫ = 0)
    (hFline : F ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({A, B} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))
    (hFperp : ⟪C -ᵥ F, B -ᵥ A⟫ = 0)
    (hPperp : ⟪P -ᵥ H, C -ᵥ B⟫ = 0)
    (hPmid : midpoint ℝ H P ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))
    (hOA : dist O A = r) (hOF : dist O F = r) (hOP : dist O P = r) :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ ({A, F, P} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))

name: Usamo2025P4.p4_perp

name: Usamo2025P4.p4_reduction
statement:
lemma p4_reduction (B C O X Y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

Usa2025P5.card_filter_dvd_succ_range
statement:
lemma card_filter_dvd_succ_range (p i : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ((range i).filter (fun j => p ∣ j + 1)).card = i / p

name: Usa2025P5.choose_cast_zmod
statement:
lemma choose_cast_zmod {p e n M i : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hdvd : p ^ e ∣ n + 1)
    (hM : p * M = n + 1) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    ((n.choose i : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ e))
      = (-1) ^ (i - i / p) * (((M - 1).choose (i / p) : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ e))

name: Usa2025P5.choose_mul_prod_filter_eq
statement:
lemma choose_mul_prod_filter_eq {p n M i : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hM : p * M = n + 1) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    n.choose i * ∏ j ∈ (range i).filter (fun j => ¬ p ∣ j + 1), (j + 1)
      = (M - 1).choose (i / p) * ∏ j ∈ (range i).filter (fun j => ¬ p ∣ j + 1), (n - j)

name: Usa2025P5.dvd_sum_of_even
statement:
lemma dvd_sum_of_even {k : ℕ} (hk : Even k) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < n → (n + 1) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose i) ^ k

name: Usa2025P5.even_of_dvd
Usa2025P5.filter_dvd_succ_range
statement:
lemma filter_dvd_succ_range (p i : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (range i).filter (fun j => p ∣ j + 1)
      = (range (i / p)).image (fun ℓ => p * (ℓ + 1) - 1)

name: Usa2025P5.injOn_mul_succ_sub_one
statement:
lemma injOn_mul_succ_sub_one (p M : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Set.InjOn (fun ℓ => p * (ℓ + 1) - 1) ↑(range M)

name: Usa2025P5.sum_modEq
statement:
lemma sum_modEq {p e n M k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hdvd : p ^ e ∣ n + 1)
    (hk : Even k) (hM : p * M = n + 1) :
    (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose i) ^ k)
      ≡ p * (∑ m ∈ range M, ((M - 1).choose m) ^ k) [MOD p ^ e]

name: Usa2025P5.sum_range_mul
statement:
lemma sum_range_mul {M' : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M'] (f : ℕ → M') (p M : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (p * M), f i = ∑ m ∈ range M, ∑ r ∈ range p, f (p * m + r)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.CircleEmb.congr_D
statement:
lemma CircleEmb.congr_D {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {m' : ℕ} [NeZero m']
    {D₁ D₂ : Finset (ZMod m)} {hD₁ : D₁ ≠ Finset.univ} {hD₂ : D₂ ≠ Finset.univ}
    {φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m} (h : D₁ = D₂) (he : CircleEmb D₁ hD₁ φ) :
    CircleEmb D₂ hD₂ φ

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.arcOf_cover
statement:
lemma arcOf_cover (hk : 0 < k) [NeZero m] (x : ZMod m) :
    ∃ i : Fin k, x ∈ P.arcOf i

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.arcOf_disjoint
statement:
lemma arcOf_disjoint (hk : 0 < k) [NeZero m] {i j : Fin k} (h : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (P.arcOf i) (P.arcOf j)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.arcSet_card
statement:
lemma arcSet_card {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {c : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ m) :
    (arcSet c l).card = l

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.arcSet_univ
statement:
lemma arcSet_univ {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {c : ZMod m} :
    arcSet c m = Finset.univ

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.base_add_pos
statement:
lemma base_add_pos [NeZero m] (x : ZMod m) :
    P.base + (P.pos x : ZMod m) = x

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circleEmb_comp_skipMap
statement:
lemma circleEmb_comp_skipMap {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} [NeZero (m - l)]
    (hl : l ≤ m) {m₂ : ℕ} [NeZero m₂] (D₂ : Finset (ZMod (m - l))) (hD₂ : D₂ ≠ Finset.univ)
    (ψ : ZMod m₂ → ZMod (m - l)) (hψ : CircleEmb D₂ hD₂ ψ)
    (hD : arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l) ≠ Finset.univ) :
    CircleEmb (arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l)) hD ((skipMap a₀ l) ∘ ψ) where
  inj

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circleEmb_factor
statement:
lemma circleEmb_factor {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {m' : ℕ} [NeZero m'] {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ}
    [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m)
    (D₂ : Finset (ZMod (m - l))) (hD₂ : D₂ ≠ Finset.univ)
    (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hDeq : D = arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l))
    (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m) (hφ : CircleEmb D hD φ) :
    ∃ φ' : ZMod m' → ZMod (m - l), (skipMap a₀ l ∘ φ') = φ ∧ CircleEmb D₂ hD₂ φ'

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circleEmb_skipMap
statement:
lemma circleEmb_skipMap [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m) (hlD : arcSet a₀ l ≠ Finset.univ) :
    CircleEmb (arcSet a₀ l) hlD (skipMap a₀ l) where
  inj

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circlePartition_cast_arcOf
statement:
lemma circlePartition_cast_arcOf {m a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) (P : CirclePartition m a) (i : Fin b) :
    (CirclePartition.cast h P).arcOf i = P.arcOf (Fin.cast h.symm i)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circlePartition_cast_len
statement:
lemma circlePartition_cast_len {m a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) (P : CirclePartition m a) (i : Fin b) :
    (CirclePartition.cast h P).len i = P.len (Fin.cast h.symm i)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.circlePartition_cast_off
statement:
lemma circlePartition_cast_off {m a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) (P : CirclePartition m a) (i : Fin b) :
    (CirclePartition.cast h P).off i = P.off (Fin.cast h.symm i)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.exists_Ico_of_mono
statement:
lemma exists_Ico_of_mono {off : ℕ → ℕ} {K p : ℕ} (h0 : off 0 ≤ p) (hp : p < off K) :
    ∃ j < K, off j ≤ p ∧ p < off (j + 1)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.exists_gap
statement:
lemma exists_gap (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ) (x : ZMod m) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ m ∧ x + (t : ZMod m) ∉ D

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.gapSize_mem
statement:
lemma gapSize_mem (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ) (x : ZMod m) {s : ℕ}
    (h1 : 1 ≤ s) (h2 : s < gapSize D hD x) : x + (s : ZMod m) ∈ D

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.gapSize_spec
statement:
lemma gapSize_spec (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ) (x : ZMod m) :
    1 ≤ gapSize D hD x ∧ gapSize D hD x ≤ m ∧ x + (gapSize D hD x : ZMod m) ∉ D

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.hall_deficiency
statement:
theorem hall_deficiency {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (pip : Fin n) (hpip : ∀ j, r pip j) :
    ∃ (M T : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → Fin n),
      pip ∈ M ∧
      T.card = M.card ∧
      (∀ p ∈ M, f p ∈ T ∧ r p (f p)) ∧
      (∀ p₁ ∈ M, ∀ p₂ ∈ M, f p₁ = f p₂ → p₁ = p₂) ∧
      (∀ p, p ∉ M → ∀ j ∈ T, ¬ r p j)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.k_pos
statement: lemma k_pos (P : CirclePartition m k) (hm : 0 < m) : 0 < k

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.len_congr
statement:
lemma len_congr (hk : 0 < k) {a : ℕ} {j : Fin k} (h : a % k = j.val) :
    P.len ⟨a % k, Nat.mod_lt a hk⟩ = P.len j

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.len_le
statement: lemma len_le (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin k) : P.len i ≤ m

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.mem_arcSet
statement:
lemma mem_arcSet {m : ℕ} {c : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} {x : ZMod m} :
    x ∈ arcSet c l ↔ ∃ t : ℕ, t < l ∧ c + (t : ZMod m) = x

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.mem_arcSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_arcSet_iff (hl : l ≤ m) (u s : ℕ) :
    (a₀ + ((l + u + s : ℕ) : ZMod m)) ∈ arcSet a₀ l ↔ (l + u + s) % m < l

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.mem_image_skipMap
statement:
lemma mem_image_skipMap (D₂ : Finset (ZMod (m - l))) [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m)
    (z : ZMod (m - l)) :
    skipMap a₀ l z ∈ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l) ↔ z ∈ D₂

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.mergeOne
statement:
lemma mergeOne {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] (P : CirclePartition m k) (hk : 0 < k) (hk2 : 2 ≤ k)
    (w : ZMod m → ℝ) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (hval : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf i, w x)
    {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} (hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (hlm : l ≤ m)
    (hA : ∑ x ∈ arcSet a₀ l, w x < 1) :
    ∃ (P' : CirclePartition (m - l) (k - 1)),
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P'.arcOf i, (w ∘ skipMap a₀ l) x)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.mergeValues
statement:
lemma mergeValues {t : ℕ} :
    ∀ {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] (P : CirclePartition m k) (_hk : 0 < k)
    (ca : Fin t → ZMod m) (la : Fin t → ℕ) (w : ZMod m → ℝ)
    (_hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (_hval : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf i, w x)
    (_hla1 : ∀ s, 1 ≤ la s) (_hlam : ∀ s, la s ≤ m)
    (_hdij : ∀ s₁ s₂, s₁ ≠ s₂ → Disjoint (arcSet (ca s₁) (la s₁)) (arcSet (ca s₂) (la s₂)))
    (_harcval : ∀ s, ∑ x ∈ arcSet (ca s) (la s), w x < 1)
    (_htk : t < k)
    {m' : ℕ} [NeZero m'] (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m)
    {hD : (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) ≠ Finset.univ}
    (_hφ : CircleEmb _ hD φ),
    ∃ P' : CirclePartition m' (k - t), ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P'.arcOf i, (w ∘ φ) x

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.natCast_injective_of_lt
statement:

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.nextD_ne_univ

lemma nextD_ne_univ (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ) (x : ZMod m) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.nextD_notMem
statement:
lemma nextD_notMem (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ) (x : ZMod m) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_add_mul_period
statement:
lemma offExt_add_mul_period (hk : 0 < k) (a q : ℕ) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_add_period
statement:
lemma offExt_add_period (hk : 0 < k) (a : ℕ) :
    P.offExt hk (a + k) = P.offExt hk a + m

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_eq_off_add_div
statement:
lemma offExt_eq_off_add_div (hk : 0 < k) (a : ℕ) {j : Fin k} (hj : a % k = j.val) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_k
statement: lemma offExt_k (hk : 0 < k) : P.offExt hk k = m

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_lt_succ
statement: lemma offExt_lt_succ (hk : 0 < k) (a : ℕ) : P.offExt hk a < P.offExt hk (a + 1)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_mono

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_strictMono
statement: lemma offExt_strictMono (hk : 0 < k) : StrictMono (P.offExt hk)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_succ

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_succ_fin
statement:

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.offExt_zero

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.off_eq_offExt

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.off_le_off

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.off_zero

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.perW_periodic
statement: lemma perW_periodic (w : ZMod m → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : P.perW w (t + m) = P.perW w t

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.perW_sum_mono
Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.perW_sum_nonneg
statement:
lemma perW_sum_nonneg (w : ZMod m → ℝ) (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (a b : ℕ) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.perW_sum_period

lemma perW_sum_period (w : ZMod m → ℝ) (q a s : ℕ) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.perW_sum_shift

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.pos_start_add

lemma pos_start_add (hk : 0 < k) [NeZero m] (i : Fin k) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < P.len i) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_add
statement:
lemma skipMap_add (i : ZMod (m - l)) (s : ℕ) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_cover
statement:
lemma skipMap_cover [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m) (y : ZMod m) (hy : y ∉ arcSet a₀ l) :

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_eq
statement:
lemma skipMap_eq (j : ZMod (m - l)) :
    skipMap a₀ l j = a₀ + ((l + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod m)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_injective
statement:
lemma skipMap_injective [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m) :
    Function.Injective (skipMap a₀ l)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_next
statement:
lemma skipMap_next [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m) (hlD : arcSet a₀ l ≠ Finset.univ)
    (i : ZMod (m - l)) :
    skipMap a₀ l (i + 1) = nextD (arcSet a₀ l) hlD (skipMap a₀ l i)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_nextD
statement:
lemma skipMap_nextD [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m)
    (D₂ : Finset (ZMod (m - l))) (hD₂ : D₂ ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hD : arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l) ≠ Finset.univ)
    (x : ZMod (m - l)) :
    skipMap a₀ l (nextD D₂ hD₂ x) =
      nextD (arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l)) hD (skipMap a₀ l x)

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.skipMap_notMem
statement:
lemma skipMap_notMem [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m) (i : ZMod (m - l)) :
    skipMap a₀ l i ∉ arcSet a₀ l

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.sum_arcOf
statement:
lemma sum_arcOf (hk : 0 < k) [NeZero m] (i : Fin k) (w : ZMod m → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf i, w x = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico (P.off i) (P.off i + P.len i), P.perW w t

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.sum_arcOf_ext
statement:
lemma sum_arcOf_ext (hk : 0 < k) [NeZero m] (a : ℕ) {j : Fin k} (hj : a % k = j.val)
    (w : ZMod m → ℝ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico (P.offExt hk a) (P.offExt hk a + P.len j), P.perW w t
      = ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf j, w x

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.sum_arcSet
statement:
lemma sum_arcSet {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {c : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ m) (w : ZMod m → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ arcSet c l, w x = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range l, w (c + (t : ZMod m))

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.surgeryMany
statement:
lemma surgeryMany {t : ℕ} :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (ca : Fin t → ZMod m) (la : Fin t → ℕ)
    (_hla1 : ∀ s, 1 ≤ la s) (_hlam : ∀ s, la s ≤ m)
    (_hdij : ∀ s₁ s₂, s₁ ≠ s₂ → Disjoint (arcSet (ca s₁) (la s₁)) (arcSet (ca s₂) (la s₂)))
    (hD : (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) ≠ Finset.univ),
    ∃ (m' : ℕ) (_ : NeZero m') (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m),
      CircleEmb (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) hD φ ∧
      m' = m - ∑ s, la s

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.transport_arc
statement:
lemma transport_arc {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} [NeZero (m - l)]
    (hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (hl : l ≤ m) {c : ZMod m} {l₁ : ℕ} (hl₁ : 1 ≤ l₁)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (arcSet a₀ l) (arcSet c l₁)) :
    ∃ v : ZMod (m - l), l₁ ≤ m - l ∧
      (arcSet v l₁).image (skipMap a₀ l) = arcSet c l₁ ∧
      (∀ w : ZMod m → ℝ, ∑ x ∈ arcSet c l₁, w x = ∑ y ∈ arcSet v l₁, w (skipMap a₀ l y))

name: Usa2025P6.CirclePartition.usa2025_p6_main
statement:
theorem usa2025_p6_main (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) : ∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (_hmn : N ≤ m)
    (like : Fin N → ZMod m → ℝ) (_hnn : ∀ p c, 0 ≤ like p c)
    (_hpart : ∀ p, ∃ P : CirclePartition m N, ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf i, like p x),
    ∃ a : ZMod m → Fin N, ∀ p, 1 ≤ ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.filter (a · = p), like p c

name: Usa2026P1.T_eq_zero_of_small_y
statement:
lemma T_eq_zero_of_small_y (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hy1 : 0 < y) (hy2 : y ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) :
  T n y = 0

name: Usa2026P1.T_nonneg
statement:
lemma T_nonneg (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hy1 : 0 < y) (hy2 : y ≤ 1) :
  0 ≤ T n y

name: Usa2026P1.core_sum_bound
statement:
lemma core_sum_bound (n p : ℕ) (hp1 : 1 ≤ p) (hpn : p < n) :
  ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, (((⌈(k : ℝ) * ((p + 1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))⌉ : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)

name: Usa2026P1.f_periodic
statement: lemma f_periodic (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : f n (x + 1) = f n x

name: Usa2026P1.f_rewrite
statement: lemma f_rewrite (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y : ℝ) : f n (1 - y) = solution_value n - T n y

name: Usa2026P2.IsPow2.pos
statement: theorem IsPow2.pos {x : ℕ} (h : IsPow2 x) : 0 < x

name: Usa2026P2.Move.append_left
statement:
theorem Move.append_left (l : List ℕ) {a b : List ℕ} (h : Move a b) :
    Move (l ++ a) (l ++ b)

name: Usa2026P2.Move.append_right
statement:
theorem Move.append_right {a b : List ℕ} (h : Move a b) (r : List ℕ) :
    Move (a ++ r) (b ++ r)

name: Usa2026P2.S_append
statement:
theorem S_append : ∀ (p q : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), p ≠ [] → q ≠ [] →
    S (p ++ x :: q) = S (p ++ [x]) + S (x :: q)
  | [], _, _, h, _ => (h rfl).elim
  | [p₁], q, x, _, hq => by
      obtain ⟨q₁, q', rfl⟩

name: Usa2026P2.S_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem S_cons_cons (x y : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) :
    S (x :: y :: rest) = 2 * x + innerSum (y :: rest)

name: Usa2026P2.S_cons_cons_append
statement:
theorem S_cons_cons_append (p₁ p₂ : ℕ) (p'' l : List ℕ) (h : p'' ++ l ≠ []) :
    S ((p₁ :: p₂ :: p'') ++ l) = 2 * p₁ + (S ((p₂ :: p'') ++ l) + 2 * p₂)

name: Usa2026P2.S_lt_four_mul_sum
statement:
theorem S_lt_four_mul_sum : ∀ (a : List ℕ), a ≠ [] → (∀ x ∈ a, 0 < x) → S a < 4 * a.sum
  | [], h, _ => (h rfl).elim
  | [x], _, h => by
      have hx : 0 < x

name: Usa2026P2.S_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem S_nil : S [] = 0

name: Usa2026P2.S_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem S_singleton (x : ℕ) : S [x] = x

name: Usa2026P2.exists_reduces_le
statement:
theorem exists_reduces_le :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : List ℕ, a.length = n → a ≠ [] → (∀ x ∈ a, IsPow2 x) →
      ∃ m, Reduces a m ∧ m ≤ S a

name: Usa2026P2.exists_split
statement:
theorem exists_split (a : List ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a.length) :
    ∃ k, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < a.length ∧ 2 * S (a.take k) ≤ S a ∧ 2 * S (a.drop k) ≤ S a

name: Usa2026P2.innerSum_cons
statement:
theorem innerSum_cons (y : ℕ) (m : List ℕ) (hm : m ≠ []) :
    innerSum (y :: m) = S (y :: m) + 2 * y

name: Usa2026P2.innerSum_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem innerSum_cons_cons (x y : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) :
    innerSum (x :: y :: rest) = 4 * x + innerSum (y :: rest)

name: Usa2026P2.innerSum_le_four_mul_sum
statement:
theorem innerSum_le_four_mul_sum : ∀ l : List ℕ, innerSum l ≤ 4 * l.sum
  | [] => by simp
  | [x] => by simp; lia
  | x :: y :: rest => by
      have ih

name: Usa2026P2.innerSum_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem innerSum_nil : innerSum [] = 0

name: Usa2026P2.innerSum_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem innerSum_singleton (x : ℕ) : innerSum [x] = 2 * x

name: Usa2026P2.reduces_isPow2
statement:
theorem reduces_isPow2 {l : List ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : Reduces l m)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ l, IsPow2 x) : IsPow2 m

name: Usa2026P2.reduces_moves
statement:
theorem reduces_moves {a : List ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : Reduces a m) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen Move a [m]

name: Usa2026P2.reflTransGen_map
Usa2026P2.two_mul_getLast_le_S
statement:
theorem two_mul_getLast_le_S (a : List ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a.length) (h : a ≠ []) :
    2 * a.getLast h ≤ S a

name: Usa2026P2.two_mul_last_le_innerSum
statement:
theorem two_mul_last_le_innerSum : ∀ (q : List ℕ) (y : ℕ), 2 * y ≤ innerSum (q ++ [y])
  | [], y => le_refl _
  | [x], y => by
      simp only [List.singleton_append, innerSum_cons_cons, innerSum_singleton]
      lia
  | x :: z :: q', y => by
      have ih

name: Usa2026P4.add_correction_not_has_digit_one
statement:
lemma add_correction_not_has_digit_one {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1)))
    (h : ((m - (10 ^ k - 1)) / 10 ^ k) ≠ 1) : ¬has_digit_one (m - (10 ^ k - 1) + correction m k)

name: Usa2026P4.chop_off_leading
statement:
lemma chop_off_leading {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1)))
    : m = ofDigits 10 ((digits 10 m).take k ++ [m / 10 ^ k])

name: Usa2026P4.correction_le
statement: lemma correction_le {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1))) : correction m k ≤ ofDigits 10 (replicate k 9)

name: Usa2026P4.digit_squeeze
statement: lemma digit_squeeze {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Set.Ico (10 ^ k) (2 * 10 ^ k)) : 1 ∈ digits 10 m

name: Usa2026P4.digits_def'
statement: lemma digits_def' : ∀ {n : ℕ} (_ : 0 < n), digits 10 n = (n % 10) :: digits 10 (n / 10)

name: Usa2026P4.digits_div_subset
statement: lemma digits_div_subset (a k : ℕ) : digits 10 (a % 10 ^ (k + 1)) ⊆ digits 10 a

name: Usa2026P4.digits_last_mem
statement: lemma digits_last_mem {m k : ℕ} (h2 : 10 ^ k ≤ m) (h3 : m / 10 ^ k < 10) : m / (10 ^ k) ∈ digits 10 m

name: Usa2026P4.digits_ofDigits
statement: lemma digits_ofDigits (L : List ℕ) (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ L, l < 10) (w₂ : ∀ h : L ≠ [], L.getLast h ≠ 0) : digits 10 (ofDigits 10 L) = L

name: Usa2026P4.digits_ofDigits'
statement:
lemma digits_ofDigits' (L : List ℕ) (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ L, l < 10)
    : digits 10 (ofDigits 10 L) = rdropWhile (· = 0) L

name: Usa2026P4.leading_ne_one
statement:
lemma leading_ne_one {m k : ℕ} (solitary : is_solitary m)
  (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1))) (hm1 : m ≠ 2 * 10 ^ k - 1)
  (hm2 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (10 ^ k), is_solitary n → m ≠ 2 * 10 ^ k + n)
    : (m - (10 ^ k - 1)) / 10 ^ k ≠ 1

name: Usa2026P4.mem_digits_split
statement:
lemma mem_digits_split {a k : ℕ} (h : a < 10 ^ k) {b : ℕ} (hb₂ : 0 < b)
    : 1 ∉ digits 10 a ∧ 1 ∉ digits 10 b ↔ 1 ∉ digits 10 (a + 10 ^ k * b)

name: Usa2026P4.nines
statement: lemma nines (k : ℕ) : 10 ^ k - 1 = ofDigits 10 (replicate k 9)

name: Usa2026P4.nines_sub_correction
statement:
lemma nines_sub_correction {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1))) : ofDigits 10 (replicate k 9) - correction m k =
    ((take k (digits 10 (m - (10 ^ k - 1))) |>.map (if · = 1 then 8 else 9)) ++ replicate (k - (digits 10 (m - (10 ^ k - 1))).length) 9 |> ofDigits 10)

name: Usa2026P4.nines_sub_correction_not_has_digit_one
statement: lemma nines_sub_correction_not_has_digit_one {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1))) : ¬has_digit_one (10 ^ k - 1 - correction m k)

name: Usa2026P4.not_solitary_two_zeros
statement: lemma not_solitary_two_zeros {k : ℕ} : ¬ is_solitary (2 * 10 ^ k)

name: Usa2026P4.one_not_mem_bumped
statement:
lemma one_not_mem_bumped (m k : ℕ) : 1 ∉
    digits 10 (ofDigits 10 (take k (map (fun a ↦ a + if a = 1 then 1 else 0) (digits 10 (m - (10 ^ k - 1))))))

name: Usa2026P4.solitary_count
statement: lemma solitary_count (k : ℕ) : Finset.card { x ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (10^k) | is_solitary x } = 2 ^ k - 1

name: Usa2026P4.solitary_extend
statement: lemma solitary_extend {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 0 < n) {k : ℕ} (hn2 : n < 10 ^ k) : is_solitary n ↔ is_solitary (2 * 10 ^ k + n)

name: Usa2026P4.solitary_form
statement: lemma solitary_form (k : ℕ) : is_solitary (2 * 10 ^ k - 1)

name: Usa2026P4.solitary_iff
statement:
lemma solitary_iff {m k : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Finset.Ico (10 ^ k) (10 ^ (k + 1))) :
    is_solitary m ↔ m = 2 * 10 ^ k - 1 ∨ (∃ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (10 ^ k), is_solitary n ∧ m = 2 * 10 ^ k + n)

name: Usa2026P4.zero_lt_mod_ne_zero
statement: lemma zero_lt_mod_ne_zero {a k : ℕ} (ha: a % k ≠ 0) : 0 < a

name: Usa2026P6.fibPair_fib
statement:
lemma fibPair_fib {a b : ℕ} (h : FibPair a b) :
    (∃ m, a = Nat.fib m) ∧ (∃ n, b = Nat.fib n)

name: Usa2026P6.fib_add_four
statement: lemma fib_add_four (n : ℕ) : Nat.fib (n + 4) + Nat.fib n = 3 * Nat.fib (n + 2)

name: Usa2026P6.fib_pair
statement:
lemma fib_pair {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1 = 3 * a * b) : FibPair a b

name: Usa2026P6.fib_pair_aux
statement:
lemma fib_pair_aux {s : ℕ}
    (IH : ∀ t : ℕ, t < s → ∀ a b : ℕ, a + b = t → 0 < a → 0 < b →
      a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1 = 3 * a * b → FibPair a b)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hsum : a + b = s) (hle : a ≤ b)
    (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1 = 3 * a * b) : FibPair a b

name: Usa2026P6.quotient_eq_three
statement:
lemma quotient_eq_three {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdvd : a * b ∣ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1) : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1) / (a * b) = 3

name: Usa2026P6.quotient_eq_three_aux
statement:
lemma quotient_eq_three_aux {s : ℕ}
    (IH : ∀ t : ℕ, t < s → ∀ a b : ℕ, a + b = t → 0 < a → 0 < b →
      a * b ∣ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1 → (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1) / (a * b) = 3)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hsum : a + b = s) (hle : a ≤ b)
    (hdvd : a * b ∣ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1) : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 1) / (a * b) = 3

name: Usa2026P6.sq_mod_four_of_even
statement: lemma sq_mod_four_of_even {x : ℕ} (hx : x % 2 = 0) : x ^ 2 % 4 = 0

name: Usa2026P6.sq_mod_four_of_odd
statement: lemma sq_mod_four_of_odd {x : ℕ} (hx : x % 2 = 1) : x ^ 2 % 4 = 1

name: Usa2026P6.sq_mod_two
statement: lemma sq_mod_two (x : ℕ) : x ^ 2 % 2 = x % 2
